variable {B : Type*} [Ring B]

/-! ### Stage 0: Canonical Non-Commutative Ring Operations & Knuth–Bendix Normalizer -/

def comm (X Y : B) : B := X * Y - Y * X
def anticomm (X Y : B) : B := X * Y + Y * X
def idemDefect (X : B) : B := X * X - X
def idemDefectBar (X : B) : B := X * X + X
def mandelbrotStep (C X : B) : B := X * X + C

def invS (P : B) : B := P - (1 - P)
def conePlus (P A : B) : B := P * A * (1 - P)
def coneMinus (P C : B) : B := (1 - P) * C * P

def peirce11 (P X : B) : B := P * X * P
def peirce00 (P X : B) : B := (1 - P) * X * (1 - P)
def evenGrade (P X : B) : B := P * X * P + (1 - P) * X * (1 - P)
def oddGrade (P X : B) : B := P * X * (1 - P) + (1 - P) * X * P

def genPhi (P A C : B) : B := conePlus P A + coneMinus P C
def genJ   (P A C : B) : B := conePlus P A - coneMinus P C
def genV   (P A C : B) : B := anticomm (conePlus P A) (coneMinus P C)
def genSig (P A C : B) : B := comm (conePlus P A) (coneMinus P C)

def qgtPlus  (P A C : B) : B := conePlus P A * coneMinus P C
def qgtMinus (P A C : B) : B := coneMinus P C * conePlus P A

def derivSqPhi (P A C X : B) : B := -comm (genPhi P A C) (comm (genPhi P A C) X)
def derivSqJ   (P A C X : B) : B := comm (genJ P A C) (comm (genJ P A C) X)
def derivSqSig (P A C X : B) : B := -comm (genSig P A C) (comm (genSig P A C) X)
def derivCasimir (P A C X : B) : B := derivSqPhi P A C X + derivSqJ P A C X + derivSqSig P A C X

def projV   (P A C X : B) : B := (8 : ℤ) • X + derivCasimir P A C X
def projPhi (P A C X : B) : B := derivSqPhi P A C X - derivSqJ P A C X - derivSqSig P A C X
def projJ   (P A C X : B) : B := derivSqJ P A C X - derivSqPhi P A C X - derivSqSig P A C X
def projSig (P A C X : B) : B := derivSqSig P A C X - derivSqPhi P A C X - derivSqJ P A C X

def hProjV (P A C X : B) : B :=
  (8 : ℤ) • ((genV P A C * genV P A C) * X) +
  (genV P A C * derivSqPhi P A C X + genV P A C * derivSqJ P A C X + derivSqSig P A C X)
def hProjPhi (P A C X : B) : B :=
  genV P A C * derivSqPhi P A C X - genV P A C * derivSqJ P A C X - derivSqSig P A C X
def hProjJ (P A C X : B) : B :=
  genV P A C * derivSqJ P A C X - genV P A C * derivSqPhi P A C X - derivSqSig P A C X
def hProjSig (P A C X : B) : B :=
  derivSqSig P A C X - genV P A C * derivSqPhi P A C X - genV P A C * derivSqJ P A C X

def grpId  (P A C X : B) : B := (genV P A C * genV P A C) * X
def grpPhi (P A C X : B) : B := genV P A C * (genPhi P A C * X * genPhi P A C)
def grpJ   (P A C X : B) : B := -(genV P A C * (genJ P A C * X * genJ P A C))
def grpSig (P A C X : B) : B := genSig P A C * X * genSig P A C

def fourierV (P A C X : B) : B :=
  (2 : ℤ) • (grpId P A C X + grpPhi P A C X + grpJ P A C X + grpSig P A C X)
def fourierPhi (P A C X : B) : B :=
  (2 : ℤ) • (grpId P A C X + grpPhi P A C X - grpJ P A C X - grpSig P A C X)
def fourierJ (P A C X : B) : B :=
  (2 : ℤ) • (grpId P A C X - grpPhi P A C X + grpJ P A C X - grpSig P A C X)
def fourierSig (P A C X : B) : B :=
  (2 : ℤ) • (grpId P A C X - grpPhi P A C X - grpJ P A C X + grpSig P A C X)

def sandwichCross (P A C X : B) : B :=
  conePlus P A * X * coneMinus P C + coneMinus P C * X * conePlus P A
def sandwichSame (P A C X : B) : B :=
  conePlus P A * X * conePlus P A + coneMinus P C * X * coneMinus P C

def ladderMinus (P A C X : B) : B := comm (genPhi P A C) (comm (genJ P A C) X)
def ladderPlus  (P A C X : B) : B := comm (genJ P A C) (comm (genPhi P A C) X)
def ladderSum   (P A C X : B) : B := ladderMinus P A C X + ladderPlus P A C X

def conjPlus (P A X : B) : B := (1 + conePlus P A) * X * (1 - conePlus P A)
def conjPlusInv (P A X : B) : B := (1 - conePlus P A) * X * (1 + conePlus P A)
def conjMinus (P C X : B) : B := (1 + coneMinus P C) * X * (1 - coneMinus P C)
def conjMinusInv (P C X : B) : B := (1 - coneMinus P C) * X * (1 + coneMinus P C)

def weylJ (P A C : B) : B := genJ P A C + (1 - genV P A C)
def weylJInv (P A C : B) : B := -genJ P A C + (1 - genV P A C)

def steinbergBraid (P A C : B) : B :=
  (1 + conePlus P A) * (1 - coneMinus P C) * (1 + conePlus P A)
def steinbergBraidInv (P A C : B) : B :=
  (1 - conePlus P A) * (1 + coneMinus P C) * (1 - conePlus P A)
def steinbergBraidDual (P A C : B) : B :=
  (1 - coneMinus P C) * (1 + conePlus P A) * (1 - coneMinus P C)
def steinbergBraidDualInv (P A C : B) : B :=
  (1 + coneMinus P C) * (1 - conePlus P A) * (1 + coneMinus P C)

def moebiusBruhat (P A C : B) : B := (1 + conePlus P A) * (1 - coneMinus P C)
def moebiusBruhatInv (P A C : B) : B := (1 + coneMinus P C) * (1 - conePlus P A)
def moebiusConj (P A C X : B) : B := moebiusBruhat P A C * X * moebiusBruhatInv P A C

def idemTrans (P A : B) : B := conjPlus P A P
def idemTransv (P C : B) : B := conjMinus P C P
def crossRatio (P Q R S : B) : B := anticomm (P - R) (Q - S)
def bergmanOp (P A C X : B) : B := (1 - qgtPlus P A C) * X * (1 - qgtMinus P A C)
def bergmanHua (P_A P_C : B) : B := 1 - (P_A - P_C) * (P_A - P_C)

def zornConj (P X : B) : B := invS P * X * invS P
def galoisNormZorn (P X : B) : B := X * zornConj P X
def galoisTraceZorn (P X : B) : B := X + zornConj P X

def hodgeStar (P X : B) : B := invS P * X
def superDerivPlus (P A X : B) : B := conePlus P A * X - zornConj P X * conePlus P A
def superDerivMinus (P C X : B) : B := coneMinus P C * X - zornConj P X * coneMinus P C
def superDerivPlusBar (P A X : B) : B := conePlus P A * X + zornConj P X * conePlus P A
def superDerivMinusBar (P C X : B) : B := coneMinus P C * X + zornConj P X * coneMinus P C
def superDerivPhi (P A C X : B) : B := superDerivPlus P A X + superDerivMinus P C X
def superDerivJ (P A C X : B) : B := superDerivPlus P A X - superDerivMinus P C X
def superDerivPhiBar (P A C X : B) : B := superDerivPlusBar P A X + superDerivMinusBar P C X
def superDerivJBar (P A C X : B) : B := superDerivPlusBar P A X - superDerivMinusBar P C X
def hodgeLaplacianPhi (P A C X : B) : B :=
  superDerivPhi P A C (superDerivPhiBar P A C X) +
  superDerivPhiBar P A C (superDerivPhi P A C X)

def goldenOp (P A C : B) : B := P + genPhi P A C
def goldenOpConj (P A C : B) : B := (1 - P) - genPhi P A C
def goldenOpJ (P A C : B) : B := P + genJ P A C

def eulerInv  (P A C : B) : B := 1 - genV P A C
def zetaSum1  (P A C : B) : B := 1 + genV P A C
def zetaSum2  (P A C : B) : B := 1 + genV P A C + genV P A C * genV P A C
def mangoldt2 (P A C : B) : B := genV P A C + genV P A C * genV P A C

def cyclo1 (X : B) : B := X - 1
def cyclo2 (X : B) : B := X + 1
def cyclo3 (X : B) : B := X * X + X + 1
def cyclo4 (X : B) : B := X * X + 1
def cyclo6 (X : B) : B := X * X - X + 1

def legendrePrimalPlus  (P A C : B) : B := 1 + qgtPlus P A C
def legendreDualPlus    (P A C : B) : B := 1 + qgtMinus P A C
def legendrePrimalMinus (P A C : B) : B := 1 - qgtPlus P A C
def legendreDualMinus   (P A C : B) : B := 1 - qgtMinus P A C

/-- Right-associative idempotent confluence lemma for `⟨P * P - P⟩`. -/
lemma P_assoc {P : B} (hP : P * P = P) (X : B) : P * (P * X) = P * X := by
  rw [← mul_assoc, hP]

/-! ### Stage S₁: Dual Lie–Jordan Leibniz Laws, Jacobi Identities & Dyadic Defect Tower -/

theorem stage_S1_leibniz_jacobi_and_dyadic_defect_tower (H U V X : B) :
    comm H (U * V) = comm H U * V + U * comm H V ∧
    comm H (U * V) = anticomm H U * V - U * anticomm H V ∧
    comm H (comm U V) + comm U (comm V H) + comm V (comm H U) = 0 ∧
    comm H (anticomm U V) - anticomm U (comm H V) = anticomm (comm H U) V ∧
    comm H (anticomm H U) = comm (H * H) U ∧
    idemDefect (1 - X) = idemDefect X ∧
    idemDefectBar X * idemDefect X = idemDefect (X * X) ∧
    idemDefectBar (X * X) * idemDefectBar X * idemDefect X =
      idemDefect ((X * X) * (X * X)) ∧
    (1 - X) * (1 + X) * (1 + X * X) * (1 + (X * X) * (X * X)) =
      1 - ((X * X) * (X * X)) * ((X * X) * (X * X)) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;>
    (simp only [idemDefect, idemDefectBar, comm, anticomm,
                sub_neg_eq_add, neg_mul, mul_neg, neg_neg,

/-! ### Stage S₂: Peirce–Cartan `Z₂`-Grading, `ad_P³ = ad_P` & Tangent Product Closure `p · p ⊆ k` -/

theorem stage_S2_peirce_cartan_grading_and_tangent_closure
    {P : B} (hP : P * P = P) (A C X : B) :
    invS P * invS P = 1 ∧
    peirce11 P X + peirce00 P X + conePlus P X + coneMinus P X = X ∧
    comm P (comm P A) = oddGrade P A ∧
    A - comm P (comm P A) = evenGrade P A ∧
    comm P (comm P (comm P A)) = comm P A ∧
    anticomm P (comm P A) = comm P A ∧
    comm P (comm P A * comm P C) = 0 ∧
    zornConj P X = evenGrade P X - oddGrade P X ∧
    zornConj P (zornConj P X) = X := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> peirce_abel_master hP

/-! ### Stage S₃: Nilpotent Cones, Split-Quaternion `Cl_{1,1}` Tetraktys & `so(1,2)` Lie Closure -/

theorem stage_S3_nilpotent_cones_tetraktys_and_so12_brackets
    {P : B} (hP : P * P = P) (A C : B) :
    conePlus P A * conePlus P A = 0 ∧
    coneMinus P C * coneMinus P C = 0 ∧
    genPhi P A C * genPhi P A C = genV P A C ∧
    genJ P A C * genJ P A C = -genV P A C ∧
    genPhi P A C * genPhi P A C + genJ P A C * genJ P A C = 0 ∧
    genJ P A C * genPhi P A C = genSig P A C ∧
    genPhi P A C * genJ P A C = -genSig P A C ∧
    anticomm (genPhi P A C) (genJ P A C) = 0 ∧
    genSig P A C = invS P * genV P A C ∧
    genSig P A C * genSig P A C = genV P A C * genV P A C ∧
    comm (conePlus P A) (genV P A C) = 0 ∧
    comm (coneMinus P C) (genV P A C) = 0 ∧
    comm (genPhi P A C) (genJ P A C) = -((2 : ℤ) • genSig P A C) ∧
    comm (genSig P A C) (genPhi P A C) = (2 : ℤ) • (genV P A C * genJ P A C) ∧
    comm (genSig P A C) (genJ P A C) = (2 : ℤ) • (genV P A C * genPhi P A C) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> peirce_abel_master hP

/-! ### Stage S₄: Sandwich Complementarity, Double-Derivation Trinity & Superoperator Ladders -/

theorem stage_S4_sandwich_trinity_and_superoperator_ladders
    {P : B} (hP : P * P = P) (A C X : B) :
    sandwichCross P A C X + sandwichSame P A C X = genPhi P A C * X * genPhi P A C ∧
    sandwichCross P A C X - sandwichSame P A C X = -(genJ P A C * X * genJ P A C) ∧
    (2 : ℤ) • ((2 : ℤ) • sandwichCross P A C X - anticomm (genV P A C) X) =
      derivSqPhi P A C X + derivSqJ P A C X ∧
    derivSqPhi P A C X - derivSqJ P A C X = (4 : ℤ) • sandwichSame P A C X ∧
    ladderMinus P A C (genPhi P A C) = -((4 : ℤ) • (genV P A C * genJ P A C)) ∧
    ladderMinus P A C (genJ P A C) = 0 ∧
    ladderPlus P A C (genJ P A C) = (4 : ℤ) • (genV P A C * genPhi P A C) ∧
    ladderPlus P A C (genPhi P A C) = 0 ∧
    ladderMinus P A C X - ladderPlus P A C X = -((2 : ℤ) • comm (genSig P A C) X) ∧
    ladderSum P A C (ladderSum P A C (genPhi P A C)) =
      -((16 : ℤ) • ((genV P A C * genV P A C) * genPhi P A C)) ∧
    ladderSum P A C (ladderSum P A C (genJ P A C)) =
      -((16 : ℤ) • ((genV P A C * genV P A C) * genJ P A C)) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> peirce_abel_master hP

/-! ### Stage S₅: Off-Shell Homogenized `Z₂ × Z₂` Projectors (`hProj`) & 2nd-Order Orthogonality -/

theorem stage_S5_homogenized_projectors_and_second_order_orthogonality
    {P : B} (hP : P * P = P) (A C X : B) :
    hProjV P A C X + hProjPhi P A C X + hProjJ P A C X + hProjSig P A C X =
      (8 : ℤ) • ((genV P A C * genV P A C) * X) ∧
    hProjV P A C (genV P A C) = (8 : ℤ) • ((genV P A C * genV P A C) * genV P A C) ∧
    hProjV P A C (genPhi P A C) = 0 ∧
    hProjV P A C (genJ P A C) = 0 ∧
    hProjV P A C (genSig P A C) = 0 ∧
    hProjPhi P A C (genPhi P A C) = (8 : ℤ) • ((genV P A C * genV P A C) * genPhi P A C) ∧
    hProjPhi P A C (genV P A C) = 0 ∧
    hProjPhi P A C (genJ P A C) = 0 ∧
    hProjPhi P A C (genSig P A C) = 0 ∧
    hProjJ P A C (genJ P A C) = (8 : ℤ) • ((genV P A C * genV P A C) * genJ P A C) ∧
    hProjJ P A C (genV P A C) = 0 ∧
    hProjJ P A C (genPhi P A C) = 0 ∧
    hProjJ P A C (genSig P A C) = 0 ∧
    hProjSig P A C (genSig P A C) = (8 : ℤ) • ((genV P A C * genV P A C) * genSig P A C) ∧
    hProjSig P A C (genV P A C) = 0 ∧
    hProjSig P A C (genPhi P A C) = 0 ∧
    hProjSig P A C (genJ P A C) = 0 ∧
    hProjPhi P A C (hProjPhi P A C (genPhi P A C)) =
      (8 : ℤ) • ((genV P A C * genV P A C) * hProjPhi P A C (genPhi P A C)) ∧
    hProjPhi P A C (hProjJ P A C (genJ P A C)) = 0 := by

/-! ### Stage 0: Canonical Non-Commutative Ring Operations & Bogoliubov–NJL Primitives -/

def comm (X Y : B) : B := X * Y - Y * X
def anticomm (X Y : B) : B := X * Y + Y * X

def invS (P : B) : B := P - (1 - P)
def conePlus (P A : B) : B := P * A * (1 - P)
def coneMinus (P C : B) : B := (1 - P) * C * P

def peirce11 (P X : B) : B := P * X * P
def peirce00 (P X : B) : B := (1 - P) * X * (1 - P)
def evenGrade (P X : B) : B := P * X * P + (1 - P) * X * (1 - P)
def oddGrade (P X : B) : B := P * X * (1 - P) + (1 - P) * X * P

def genPhi (P A C : B) : B := conePlus P A + coneMinus P C
def genJ   (P A C : B) : B := conePlus P A - coneMinus P C
def genV   (P A C : B) : B := anticomm (conePlus P A) (coneMinus P C)
def genSig (P A C : B) : B := comm (conePlus P A) (coneMinus P C)

def qgtPlus  (P A C : B) : B := conePlus P A * coneMinus P C
def qgtMinus (P A C : B) : B := coneMinus P C * conePlus P A

def derivSqPhi (P A C X : B) : B := -comm (genPhi P A C) (comm (genPhi P A C) X)
def derivSqJ   (P A C X : B) : B := comm (genJ P A C) (comm (genJ P A C) X)
def derivSqSig (P A C X : B) : B := -comm (genSig P A C) (comm (genSig P A C) X)

def hProjV (P A C X : B) : B :=
  (8 : ℤ) • ((genV P A C * genV P A C) * X) +
  (genV P A C * derivSqPhi P A C X + genV P A C * derivSqJ P A C X + derivSqSig P A C X)

def hProjPhi (P A C X : B) : B :=
  genV P A C * derivSqPhi P A C X - genV P A C * derivSqJ P A C X - derivSqSig P A C X

def hProjJ (P A C X : B) : B :=
  genV P A C * derivSqJ P A C X - genV P A C * derivSqPhi P A C X - derivSqSig P A C X

def hProjSig (P A C X : B) : B :=
  derivSqSig P A C X - genV P A C * derivSqPhi P A C X - genV P A C * derivSqJ P A C X

def eulerInv (P A C : B) : B := 1 - genV P A C
def zetaSum1 (P A C : B) : B := 1 + genV P A C
def idemDefect (X : B) : B := X * X - X

/-- **The Euclidean Bogoliubov–NJL Quasiparticle Operator `nambuBogoliubov P A C = S_P + Φ`**
and its **Chiral Conjugate `nambuBogoliubovConj P A C = S_P - Φ`**:

def nambuBogoliubov (P A C : B) : B := invS P + genPhi P A C
def nambuBogoliubovConj (P A C : B) : B := invS P - genPhi P A C

/-- **The Lorentzian / Skew Bogoliubov–NJL Quasiparticle Operator `nambuBogoliubovJ P A C = S_P + J`**
and its **Chiral Conjugate `nambuBogoliubovJConj P A C = S_P - J`**: -/
def nambuBogoliubovJ (P A C : B) : B := invS P + genJ P A C
def nambuBogoliubovJConj (P A C : B) : B := invS P - genJ P A C

/-! ### Part 1: Core Non-Commutative Ring Operations, Steinberg Braids, `hProj` & Hodge Differentials -/

def comm (X Y : B) : B := X * Y - Y * X
def anticomm (X Y : B) : B := X * Y + Y * X

def invS (P : B) : B := P - (1 - P)
def conePlus (P A : B) : B := P * A * (1 - P)
def coneMinus (P C : B) : B := (1 - P) * C * P

def peirce11 (P X : B) : B := P * X * P
def peirce00 (P X : B) : B := (1 - P) * X * (1 - P)
def evenGrade (P X : B) : B := P * X * P + (1 - P) * X * (1 - P)
def oddGrade (P X : B) : B := P * X * (1 - P) + (1 - P) * X * P

def genPhi (P A C : B) : B := conePlus P A + coneMinus P C
def genJ   (P A C : B) : B := conePlus P A - coneMinus P C
def genV   (P A C : B) : B := anticomm (conePlus P A) (coneMinus P C)
def genSig (P A C : B) : B := comm (conePlus P A) (coneMinus P C)

def qgtPlus  (P A C : B) : B := conePlus P A * coneMinus P C
def qgtMinus (P A C : B) : B := coneMinus P C * conePlus P A

def derivSqPhi (P A C X : B) : B := -comm (genPhi P A C) (comm (genPhi P A C) X)
def derivSqJ   (P A C X : B) : B := comm (genJ P A C) (comm (genJ P A C) X)
def derivSqSig (P A C X : B) : B := -comm (genSig P A C) (comm (genSig P A C) X)

/-- Homogenized Off-Shell Irrep Projectors `(hProjV, hProjPhi, hProjJ, hProjSig)` (File 1). -/
def hProjV (P A C X : B) : B :=
  (8 : ℤ) • ((genV P A C * genV P A C) * X) +
  (genV P A C * derivSqPhi P A C X + genV P A C * derivSqJ P A C X + derivSqSig P A C X)

def hProjPhi (P A C X : B) : B :=
  genV P A C * derivSqPhi P A C X - genV P A C * derivSqJ P A C X - derivSqSig P A C X

def hProjJ (P A C X : B) : B :=
  genV P A C * derivSqJ P A C X - genV P A C * derivSqPhi P A C X - derivSqSig P A C X

def hProjSig (P A C X : B) : B :=
  derivSqSig P A C X - genV P A C * derivSqPhi P A C X - genV P A C * derivSqJ P A C X

/-- Cayley–Weyl Operators & Steinberg Triple Unipotent Braids (File 1). -/
def weylJ (P A C : B) : B := genJ P A C + (1 - genV P A C)
def weylJInv (P A C : B) : B := -genJ P A C + (1 - genV P A C)

def steinbergBraid (P A C : B) : B :=
  (1 + conePlus P A) * (1 - coneMinus P C) * (1 + conePlus P A)
def steinbergBraidInv (P A C : B) : B :=
  (1 - conePlus P A) * (1 + coneMinus P C) * (1 - conePlus P A)
def steinbergBraidDual (P A C : B) : B :=
  (1 - coneMinus P C) * (1 + conePlus P A) * (1 - coneMinus P C)
def steinbergBraidDualInv (P A C : B) : B :=
  (1 + coneMinus P C) * (1 - conePlus P A) * (1 + coneMinus P C)

/-- Graded Coboundary (`d_±`) and Boundary (`d̄_±`) Super-Derivations & Chiral Hodge Operators (File 3). -/
def parityConj (P X : B) : B := invS P * X * invS P

def superDerivPlus (P A X : B) : B :=
  conePlus P A * X - parityConj P X * conePlus P A
def superDerivMinus (P C X : B) : B :=
  coneMinus P C * X - parityConj P X * coneMinus P C
def superDerivPlusBar (P A X : B) : B :=
  conePlus P A * X + parityConj P X * conePlus P A
def superDerivMinusBar (P C X : B) : B :=
  coneMinus P C * X + parityConj P X * coneMinus P C

def superDerivPhi (P A C X : B) : B :=
  superDerivPlus P A X + superDerivMinus P C X
def superDerivJ (P A C X : B) : B :=
  superDerivPlus P A X - superDerivMinus P C X
def superDerivPhiBar (P A C X : B) : B :=
  superDerivPlusBar P A X + superDerivMinusBar P C X
def superDerivJBar (P A C X : B) : B :=
  superDerivPlusBar P A X - superDerivMinusBar P C X

def hodgeLaplacianPhi (P A C X : B) : B :=
  superDerivPhi P A C (superDerivPhiBar P A C X) +
  superDerivPhiBar P A C (superDerivPhi P A C X)

def hodgeLaplacianSig (P A C X : B) : B :=
  superDerivJ P A C (superDerivPhiBar P A C X) +
  superDerivPhiBar P A C (superDerivJ P A C X)

/-- Confluent right-associative idempotent normalizer for `⟨P * P - P⟩`. -/
lemma P_assoc {P : B} (hP : P * P = P) (X : B) : P * (P * X) = P * X := by
  rw [← mul_assoc, hP]

/-! ### Part 2: Directed Inductive System of Star-Algebras & Colimit Cone (File 2) -/

structure StarRingHom (B₁ B₂ : Type*) [Ring B₁] [StarRing B₁] [Ring B₂] [StarRing B₂]
    extends B₁ →+* B₂ where
  map_star' : ∀ x : B₁, toRingHom (star x) = star (toRingHom x)

def StarRingHom.id (B₁ : Type*) [Ring B₁] [StarRing B₁] : StarRingHom B₁ B₁ where
  toRingHom := RingHom.id B₁
  map_star' _ := rfl

def StarRingHom.comp {B₁ B₂ B₃ : Type*}
    [Ring B₁] [StarRing B₁] [Ring B₂] [StarRing B₂] [Ring B₃] [StarRing B₃]
    (ψ : StarRingHom B₂ B₃) (φ : StarRingHom B₁ B₂) : StarRingHom B₁ B₃ where
  toRingHom := ψ.toRingHom.comp φ.toRingHom
  map_star' x := by
    change ψ.toRingHom (φ.toRingHom (star x)) = star (ψ.toRingHom (φ.toRingHom x))
    rw [φ.map_star', ψ.map_star']

structure InductiveStarColimitCone (A : ℕ → Type*) [∀ k, Ring (A k)] [∀ k, StarRing (A k)]
    (A_inf : Type*) [Ring A_inf] [StarRing A_inf] where
  stepHom : ∀ k, StarRingHom (A k) (A (k + 1))
  toColimit : ∀ k, StarRingHom (A k) A_inf
  compat : ∀ k (x : A k),
    (toColimit (k + 1)).toRingHom ((stepHom k).toRingHom x) = (toColimit k).toRingHom x

def stepHomIter {A : ℕ → Type*} [∀ k, Ring (A k)] [∀ k, StarRing (A k)]
    {A_inf : Type*} [Ring A_inf] [StarRing A_inf]
    (Cone : InductiveStarColimitCone A A_inf) (k : ℕ) :
    ∀ m : ℕ, StarRingHom (A k) (A (k + m))
  | 0 => StarRingHom.id (A k)
  | m + 1 => (Cone.stepHom (k + m)).comp (stepHomIter Cone k m)

/-! ### Theorem U₂: Inductive Colimit Lift of the Hodge–De Rham Cochain Complex & Laplacian (`A_∞`) -/

3. **Colimit Hodge–Dirac Laplacians Generate Pure Left-Multiplication by `2 V_inf`, `2 Σ_inf`, `2 Q_{±,inf}`:**

4. **Colimit De Rham Cochain Complex (`S_inf ──► (-2J_inf, -2Φ_inf) ──► (2V_inf, 2Σ_inf) ──► 0`):**

theorem colimit_hodge_de_rham_complex_and_rg_invariance_lift
    {A : ℕ → Type*} [∀ k, Ring (A k)] [∀ k, StarRing (A k)]
    {A_inf : Type*} [Ring A_inf] [StarRing A_inf]
    (Cone : InductiveStarColimitCone A A_inf)
    (k m : ℕ) (P_k A_k C_k X_k : A k) (hP_k : P_k * P_k = P_k) (X : A_inf) :
    let ψ_m := (stepHomIter Cone k m).toRingHom
    let ι_km := (Cone.toColimit (k + m)).toRingHom
    let ι_k := (Cone.toColimit k).toRingHom
    let P_inf := ι_k P_k
    let A_inf_op := ι_k A_k
    let C_inf_op := ι_k C_k
    let V_inf := genV P_inf A_inf_op C_inf_op
    let Σ_inf := genSig P_inf A_inf_op C_inf_op
    let Φ_inf := genPhi P_inf A_inf_op C_inf_op
    let J_inf := genJ P_inf A_inf_op C_inf_op
    -- 1. Multi-step RG scale invariance (`k → k + m → ∞`) of `hProjPhi` and `hodgeLaplacianPhi`:
    ι_km (hProjPhi (ψ_m P_k) (ψ_m A_k) (ψ_m C_k) (ψ_m X_k)) =
      hProjPhi P_inf A_inf_op C_inf_op (ι_k X_k) ∧
    ι_km (hodgeLaplacianPhi (ψ_m P_k) (ψ_m A_k) (ψ_m C_k) (ψ_m X_k)) =
      hodgeLaplacianPhi P_inf A_inf_op C_inf_op (ι_k X_k) ∧
    -- 2. Universal Nilpotency `d_+² = d_-² = d̄_+² = d̄_-² = 0` on `A_inf`:
    superDerivPlus P_inf A_inf_op (superDerivPlus P_inf A_inf_op X) = 0 ∧
    superDerivMinus P_inf C_inf_op (superDerivMinus P_inf C_inf_op X) = 0 ∧
    superDerivPlusBar P_inf A_inf_op (superDerivPlusBar P_inf A_inf_op X) = 0 ∧
    superDerivMinusBar P_inf C_inf_op (superDerivMinusBar P_inf C_inf_op X) = 0 ∧
    -- 3. Colimit Hodge–Dirac Laplacians on `A_inf`:
    hodgeLaplacianPhi P_inf A_inf_op C_inf_op X = (2 : ℤ) • (V_inf * X) ∧
    hodgeLaplacianSig P_inf A_inf_op C_inf_op X = (2 : ℤ) • (Σ_inf * X) ∧
    superDerivPlus P_inf A_inf_op (superDerivMinusBar P_inf C_inf_op X) +
      superDerivPlusBar P_inf A_inf_op (superDerivMinus P_inf C_inf_op X) =
      (2 : ℤ) • (qgtPlus P_inf A_inf_op C_inf_op * X) ∧
    -- 4. Colimit De Rham Cochain Complex (`S_inf ──► Φ_inf, J_inf ──► V_inf, Σ_inf ──► 0`):
    superDerivPhi P_inf A_inf_op C_inf_op (invS P_inf) = -((2 : ℤ) • J_inf) ∧
    superDerivPhi P_inf A_inf_op C_inf_op Φ_inf = (2 : ℤ) • V_inf ∧
    superDerivJBar P_inf A_inf_op C_inf_op Φ_inf = (2 : ℤ) • Σ_inf ∧
    superDerivPhi P_inf A_inf_op C_inf_op V_inf = 0 ∧
    superDerivPhiBar P_inf A_inf_op C_inf_op Σ_inf = 0 := by
  intro ψ_m ι_km ι_k P_inf A_inf_op C_inf_op V_inf Σ_inf Φ_inf J_inf
  have hP_inf : P_inf * P_inf = P_inf := by
    dsimp [P_inf, ι_k]; rw [← map_mul, hP_k]
  have hCocycle : ∀ m' : ℕ, ∀ x : A k,
      (Cone.toColimit (k + m')).toRingHom ((stepHomIter Cone k m').toRingHom x) =
      (Cone.toColimit k).toRingHom x := by
    intro m'
    induction m' with
    | zero => intro x; rfl
    | succ m' ih =>
      intro x
      change (Cone.toColimit (k + m' + 1)).toRingHom
        ((Cone.stepHom (k + m')).toRingHom ((stepHomIter Cone k m').toRingHom x)) =
        (Cone.toColimit k).toRingHom x
      rw [Cone.compat (k + m') ((stepHomIter Cone k m').toRingHom x)]
      exact ih x
  rcases starRingHom_intertwines_steinberg_hodge_and_hProj
      (stepHomIter Cone k m) P_k A_k C_k X_k with
    ⟨_, _, _, hProjPhi_m, _, _, _, _, hLap_m⟩
  rcases starRingHom_intertwines_steinberg_hodge_and_hProj
      (Cone.toColimit k) P_k A_k C_k X_k with
    ⟨_, _, _, hProjPhi_k, _, _, _, _, hLap_k⟩
  have hRG_Proj :
      ι_km (hProjPhi (ψ_m P_k) (ψ_m A_k) (ψ_m C_k) (ψ_m X_k)) =
      hProjPhi P_inf A_inf_op C_inf_op (ι_k X_k) := by
    calc ι_km (hProjPhi (ψ_m P_k) (ψ_m A_k) (ψ_m C_k) (ψ_m X_k))
      _ = ι_km (ψ_m (hProjPhi P_k A_k C_k X_k)) := congr_arg ι_km hProjPhi_m.symm
      _ = ι_k (hProjPhi P_k A_k C_k X_k) := hCocycle m _
      _ = hProjPhi P_inf A_inf_op C_inf_op (ι_k X_k) := hProjPhi_k
  have hRG_Lap :
      ι_km (hodgeLaplacianPhi (ψ_m P_k) (ψ_m A_k) (ψ_m C_k) (ψ_m X_k)) =
      hodgeLaplacianPhi P_inf A_inf_op C_inf_op (ι_k X_k) := by
    calc ι_km (hodgeLaplacianPhi (ψ_m P_k) (ψ_m A_k) (ψ_m C_k) (ψ_m X_k))
      _ = ι_km (ψ_m (hodgeLaplacianPhi P_k A_k C_k X_k)) := congr_arg ι_km hLap_m.symm
      _ = ι_k (hodgeLaplacianPhi P_k A_k C_k X_k) := hCocycle m _
      _ = hodgeLaplacianPhi P_inf A_inf_op C_inf_op (ι_k X_k) := hLap_k
  refine ⟨hRG_Proj, hRG_Lap, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;>

variable {R : Type*} [Ring R] [StarRing R]

abbrev TowerColimit (R : Type*) := ℕ → R

def colimitChannel (k : ℕ) (r : R) : TowerColimit R :=
  fun n => if n = k then r else 0

def colimitVacuum (p : R) : TowerColimit R :=
  fun _ => p

lemma colimitVacuum_idempotent {p : R} (hp : p * p = p) :
    colimitVacuum p * colimitVacuum p = colimitVacuum p := by
  funext _; exact hp

lemma colimitChannel_mul_of_ne {k₁ k₂ : ℕ} (hne : k₁ ≠ k₂) (u v : R) :
    colimitChannel k₁ u * colimitChannel k₂ v = 0 := by
  funext n
  change (if n = k₁ then u else 0) * (if n = k₂ then v else 0) = 0
  by_cases h1 : n = k₁
  · have h2 : n ≠ k₂ := fun h => hne (h1.symm.trans h)
    rw [if_pos h1, if_neg h2, mul_zero]
  · rw [if_neg h1, zero_mul]

lemma conePlus_colimitChannel (p : R) (k : ℕ) (a : R) :
    conePlus (colimitVacuum p) (colimitChannel k a) = colimitChannel k (conePlus p a) := by
  funext n
  change p * (if n = k then a else 0) * (1 - p) = if n = k then p * a * (1 - p) else 0
  by_cases h : n = k
  · rw [if_pos h, if_pos h]
  · rw [if_neg h, if_neg h, mul_zero, zero_mul]

lemma coneMinus_colimitChannel (p : R) (k : ℕ) (c : R) :
    coneMinus (colimitVacuum p) (colimitChannel k c) = colimitChannel k (coneMinus p c) := by
  funext n
  change (1 - p) * (if n = k then c else 0) * p = if n = k then (1 - p) * c * p else 0
  by_cases h : n = k
  · rw [if_pos h, if_pos h]
  · rw [if_neg h, if_neg h, mul_zero, zero_mul]

/-- **Theorem U₄.1 (Multi-Channel Orthogonal QGT & Hodge–Dirac Laplacian Additivity in `TowerColimit R`):**

   `qgtMinus P_inf (A₁ + A₂) (C₁ + C₂) = qgtMinus P_inf A₁ C₁ + qgtMinus P_inf A₂ C₂`!

   `hodgeLaplacianPhi P_inf (A₁ + A₂) (C₁ + C₂) X =`
   `hodgeLaplacianPhi P_inf A₁ C₁ X + hodgeLaplacianPhi P_inf A₂ C₂ X`! -/
theorem colimit_orthogonal_channel_qgt_and_hodge_laplacian_additivity
    {p : R} (hp : p * p = p) {k₁ k₂ : ℕ} (hne : k₁ ≠ k₂) (a₁ c₁ a₂ c₂ : R)
    (X : TowerColimit R) :
    let P_inf := colimitVacuum p
    let A₁ := colimitChannel k₁ a₁
    let C₁ := colimitChannel k₁ c₁
    let A₂ := colimitChannel k₂ a₂
    let C₂ := colimitChannel k₂ c₂

      qgtPlus P_inf A₁ C₁ + qgtPlus P_inf A₂ C₂ ∧
    qgtMinus P_inf (A₁ + A₂) (C₁ + C₂) =
      qgtMinus P_inf A₁ C₁ + qgtMinus P_inf A₂ C₂ ∧
    hodgeLaplacianPhi P_inf (A₁ + A₂) (C₁ + C₂) X =
      hodgeLaplacianPhi P_inf A₁ C₁ X + hodgeLaplacianPhi P_inf A₂ C₂ X := by
  intro P_inf A₁ C₁ A₂ C₂
  have hP_inf : P_inf * P_inf = P_inf := colimitVacuum_idempotent hp
  have h12 : conePlus P_inf A₁ * coneMinus P_inf C₂ = 0 := by
    change conePlus (colimitVacuum p) (colimitChannel k₁ a₁) *
           coneMinus (colimitVacuum p) (colimitChannel k₂ c₂) = 0
    rw [conePlus_colimitChannel, coneMinus_colimitChannel]
    exact colimitChannel_mul_of_ne hne _ _
  have h21 : conePlus P_inf A₂ * coneMinus P_inf C₁ = 0 := by
    change conePlus (colimitVacuum p) (colimitChannel k₂ a₂) *
           coneMinus (colimitVacuum p) (colimitChannel k₁ c₁) = 0
    rw [conePlus_colimitChannel, coneMinus_colimitChannel]
    exact colimitChannel_mul_of_ne hne.symm _ _

    change coneMinus (colimitVacuum p) (colimitChannel k₁ c₁) *
           conePlus (colimitVacuum p) (colimitChannel k₂ a₂) = 0
    rw [coneMinus_colimitChannel, conePlus_colimitChannel]
    exact colimitChannel_mul_of_ne hne _ _
  have h21' : coneMinus P_inf C₂ * conePlus P_inf A₁ = 0 := by
    change coneMinus (colimitVacuum p) (colimitChannel k₂ c₂) *
           conePlus (colimitVacuum p) (colimitChannel k₁ a₁) = 0
    rw [coneMinus_colimitChannel, conePlus_colimitChannel]
    exact colimitChannel_mul_of_ne hne.symm _ _
  have hPlusAdd : conePlus P_inf (A₁ + A₂) = conePlus P_inf A₁ + conePlus P_inf A₂ := by
    unfold conePlus; simp only [mul_add, add_mul]
  have hMinusAdd : coneMinus P_inf (C₁ + C₂) = coneMinus P_inf C₁ + coneMinus P_inf C₂ := by
    unfold coneMinus; simp only [mul_add, add_mul]
  have hQPlus : qgtPlus P_inf (A₁ + A₂) (C₁ + C₂) =
      qgtPlus P_inf A₁ C₁ + qgtPlus P_inf A₂ C₂ := by
    unfold qgtPlus
    rw [hPlusAdd, hMinusAdd]
    simp only [add_mul, mul_add, h12, h21]
    abel
  have hQMinus : qgtMinus P_inf (A₁ + A₂) (C₁ + C₂) =
      qgtMinus P_inf A₁ C₁ + qgtMinus P_inf A₂ C₂ := by
    unfold qgtMinus
    rw [hPlusAdd, hMinusAdd]
    simp only [add_mul, mul_add, h12', h21']
    abel
  have hVAdd : genV P_inf (A₁ + A₂) (C₁ + C₂) =
      genV P_inf A₁ C₁ + genV P_inf A₂ C₂ := by
    change qgtPlus P_inf (A₁ + A₂) (C₁ + C₂) + qgtMinus P_inf (A₁ + A₂) (C₁ + C₂) =
           (qgtPlus P_inf A₁ C₁ + qgtMinus P_inf A₁ C₁) +
           (qgtPlus P_inf A₂ C₂ + qgtMinus P_inf A₂ C₂)
    rw [hQPlus, hQMinus]; abel
  have hLapId : ∀ U W : TowerColimit R,
      hodgeLaplacianPhi P_inf U W X = (2 : ℤ) • (genV P_inf U W * X) := by
    intro U W; peirce_abel_unified hP_inf
  refine ⟨hQPlus, hQMinus, ?_⟩
  rw [hLapId (A₁ + A₂) (C₁ + C₂), hLapId A₁ C₁, hLapId A₂ C₂,
      hVAdd, add_mul, smul_add]

end UnifiedColimitHodgeSteinbergSpine

/-- Universal Orthogonality-Preserving Bifurcation Lemma for `idemDefect`. -/
theorem idemDefect_orthogonal_split {X Y : B} (hXY : X * Y = 0) (hYX : Y * X = 0) :

    idemDefect Y * idemDefect X = 0 := by
  have hXYY : X * (Y * Y) = 0 := by rw [← mul_assoc, hXY, zero_mul]
  have hYXX : Y * (X * X) = 0 := by rw [← mul_assoc, hYX, zero_mul]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [idemDefect, add_mul, mul_add, hXY, hYX]; abel
  · simp only [idemDefect, sub_mul, mul_sub, mul_assoc, hXY, hXYY, mul_zero]; abel
  · simp only [idemDefect, sub_mul, mul_sub, mul_assoc, hYX, hYXX, mul_zero]; abel

/-- **Lemma A₆₅.1 (Closure of the Centralizer `[G, Z] = 0` Under `idemDefect`):**
In any ring `B`, if `Z` commutes with `G` (`comm G Z = 0`), then `idemDefect Z = Z² - Z` also

lemma comm_idemDefect_of_comm {G Z : B} (hGZ : comm G Z = 0) :
    comm G (idemDefect Z) = 0 ∧ -comm G (comm G Z) = 0 := by
  have hEq : G * Z = Z * G := sub_eq_zero.mp hGZ

  unfold comm idemDefect
  calc G * (Z * Z - Z) - (Z * Z - Z) * G
    _ = (G * Z) * Z - G * Z - Z * (Z * G) + Z * G := by
        simp only [mul_sub, sub_mul, mul_assoc]; abel
    _ = (Z * G) * Z - Z * G - Z * (G * Z) + Z * G := by rw [hEq]
    _ = 0 := by simp only [mul_assoc]; abel

def chiralFractalBranch (n : ℕ) (P A C : B) : B :=

/-- Lemma A₆₆.1: Invariance of the 6-Fold Cone–Sheet Braiding System Under `idemDefect`. -/
lemma idemDefect_cone_sheet_braiding {N_p N_m X Y : B}
    (h1 : N_p * X = 0) (h2 : Y * N_p = 0)
    (h3 : N_m * Y = 0) (h4 : X * N_m = 0)
    (h5 : N_p * Y = X * N_p) (h6 : N_m * X = Y * N_m) :
    N_p * idemDefect X = 0 ∧
    idemDefect Y * N_p = 0 ∧
    N_m * idemDefect Y = 0 ∧
    idemDefect X * N_m = 0 ∧
    N_p * idemDefect Y = idemDefect X * N_p ∧
    N_m * idemDefect X = idemDefect Y * N_m := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · unfold idemDefect; rw [mul_sub, ← mul_assoc, h1, zero_mul, sub_self]
  · unfold idemDefect; rw [sub_mul, mul_assoc, h2, mul_zero, sub_self]
  · unfold idemDefect; rw [mul_sub, ← mul_assoc, h3, zero_mul, sub_self]
  · unfold idemDefect; rw [sub_mul, mul_assoc, h4, mul_zero, sub_self]
  · unfold idemDefect
    calc N_p * (Y * Y - Y)
      _ = (N_p * Y) * Y - N_p * Y := by rw [mul_sub, mul_assoc]
      _ = (X * N_p) * Y - X * N_p := by rw [h5]
      _ = X * (N_p * Y) - X * N_p := by rw [mul_assoc]
      _ = X * (X * N_p) - X * N_p := by rw [h5]
      _ = (X * X - X) * N_p := by rw [sub_mul, mul_assoc]
  · unfold idemDefect
    calc N_m * (X * X - X)
      _ = (N_m * X) * X - N_m * X := by rw [mul_sub, mul_assoc]
      _ = (Y * N_m) * X - Y * N_m := by rw [h6]
      _ = Y * (N_m * X) - Y * N_m := by rw [mul_assoc]
      _ = Y * (Y * N_m) - Y * N_m := by rw [h6]
      _ = (Y * Y - Y) * N_m := by rw [sub_mul, mul_assoc]

/-- Lemma A₆₆.2: All-Scale `(k, n) ∈ ℕ × ℕ` 6-Fold Cone–Sheet Braiding Theorem. -/
theorem cone_sheet_braiding_all_scales
    {P : B} (hP : P * P = P) (A C : B) (k n : ℕ) :
    let P_k := daughterIdemTower k P A
    let N_p := conePlus P_k A
    let N_m := coneMinus P_k C
    let X_n := mandelbrotTower n (qgtPlus P_k A C)
    let Y_n := mandelbrotTower n (qgtMinus P_k A C)
    N_p * X_n = 0 ∧
    Y_n * N_p = 0 ∧
    N_m * Y_n = 0 ∧
    X_n * N_m = 0 ∧
    N_p * Y_n = X_n * N_p ∧
    N_m * X_n = Y_n * N_m := by
  intro P_k N_p N_m X_n Y_n
  have hPk : P_k * P_k = P_k :=
    (archetype_A64_universal_all_scale_fractal_rg_and_mandelbrot_tower hP A C k 0).1.1
  dsimp [X_n, Y_n, N_p, N_m]
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    dsimp [mandelbrotTower]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> peirce_abel_golay hPk
  | succ n ih =>
    rcases ih with ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6⟩
    dsimp [mandelbrotTower]
    exact idemDefect_cone_sheet_braiding h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6

/-- **Theorem A₆₆.1 (Audited All-Scale `W₂₄` Leech Sector Isolation of `V_{k,n}` & Chiral Duality of `Σ_{k,n}`):** -/
theorem archetype_A66_all_scale_cone_sheet_braiding_and_leech_24_sector_isolation

    let P_k := daughterIdemTower k P A

    let V_kn := mandelbrotTower n V_k

    golay24Gp1 P_k A C V_kn = 0 ∧
    golay24Gm1 P_k A C V_kn = 0 ∧

  intro P_k V_k V_kn Sig_kn
  have hQuad := archetype_A64_universal_all_scale_fractal_rg_and_mandelbrot_tower hP A C k n
  have hPk : P_k * P_k = P_k := hQuad.1.1
  have hSplit : V_kn = mandelbrotTower n (qgtPlus P_k A C) + mandelbrotTower n (qgtMinus P_k A C) :=
    hQuad.2.1
  rcases cone_sheet_braiding_all_scales hP A C k n with ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6⟩
  set N_p := conePlus P_k A
  set N_m := coneMinus P_k C
  set X_n := mandelbrotTower n (qgtPlus P_k A C)
  set Y_n := mandelbrotTower n (qgtMinus P_k A C)
  have hNpSq : N_p * N_p = 0 := by dsimp [N_p]; peirce_abel_golay hPk
  have hNmSq : N_m * N_m = 0 := by dsimp [N_m]; peirce_abel_golay hPk
  have hNpV : N_p * V_kn = V_kn * N_p := by
    rw [hSplit]
    calc N_p * (X_n + Y_n)
      _ = N_p * X_n + N_p * Y_n := by rw [mul_add]
      _ = 0 + X_n * N_p := by rw [h1, h5]
      _ = X_n * N_p + 0 := by abel
      _ = X_n * N_p + Y_n * N_p := by rw [h2]
      _ = (X_n + Y_n) * N_p := by rw [add_mul]
  have hNmV : N_m * V_kn = V_kn * N_m := by
    rw [hSplit]
    calc N_m * (X_n + Y_n)
      _ = N_m * X_n + N_m * Y_n := by rw [mul_add]
      _ = Y_n * N_m + 0 := by rw [h6, h3]
      _ = 0 + Y_n * N_m := by abel
      _ = X_n * N_m + Y_n * N_m := by rw [h4]
      _ = (X_n + Y_n) * N_m := by rw [add_mul]
  have hCommNp : comm N_p V_kn = 0 := sub_eq_zero.mpr hNpV
  have hCommNm : comm N_m V_kn = 0 := sub_eq_zero.mpr hNmV
  have hGp1 : kantorGp1 P_k A V_kn = 0 := hCommNp
  have hGm1 : kantorGm1 P_k C V_kn = 0 := hCommNm
  have hGp2 : kantorGp2 P_k A V_kn = 0 := by
    unfold kantorGp2; change (N_p * V_kn) * N_p = 0
    rw [hNpV, mul_assoc, hNpSq, mul_zero]
  have hGm2 : kantorGm2 P_k C V_kn = 0 := by
    unfold kantorGm2; change (N_m * V_kn) * N_m = 0
    rw [hNmV, mul_assoc, hNmSq, mul_zero]
  -- Audited direct `calc` proof of `hG0` without redundant pre-`rw`:
  have hG0 : kantorG0 P_k A C V_kn = V_k * V_kn := by
    unfold kantorG0 kantorTriple
    change (N_p * V_kn) * N_m + (N_m * V_kn) * N_p = (N_p * N_m + N_m * N_p) * V_kn
    calc (N_p * V_kn) * N_m + (N_m * V_kn) * N_p
      _ = N_p * (V_kn * N_m) + N_m * (V_kn * N_p) := by rw [mul_assoc, mul_assoc]
      _ = N_p * (N_m * V_kn) + N_m * (N_p * V_kn) := by rw [← hNmV, ← hNpV]
      _ = (N_p * N_m) * V_kn + (N_m * N_p) * V_kn := by rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc]
      _ = (N_p * N_m + N_m * N_p) * V_kn := by rw [← add_mul]
  have hA61 := archetype_A61_golay_12_and_leech_24_operator_error_correcting_codes hPk A C V_kn
  have hAntiNp : anticomm N_p Sig_kn = 0 := by
    unfold anticomm chiralFractalBranch
    change N_p * (X_n - Y_n) + (X_n - Y_n) * N_p = 0
    calc N_p * (X_n - Y_n) + (X_n - Y_n) * N_p
      _ = (N_p * X_n - N_p * Y_n) + (X_n * N_p - Y_n * N_p) := by rw [mul_sub, sub_mul]
      _ = (0 - X_n * N_p) + (X_n * N_p - 0) := by rw [h1, h5, h2]
      _ = 0 := by abel
  have hAntiNm : anticomm N_m Sig_kn = 0 := by
    unfold anticomm chiralFractalBranch
    change N_m * (X_n - Y_n) + (X_n - Y_n) * N_m = 0
    calc N_m * (X_n - Y_n) + (X_n - Y_n) * N_m
      _ = (N_m * X_n - N_m * Y_n) + (X_n * N_m - Y_n * N_m) := by rw [mul_sub, sub_mul]
      _ = (Y_n * N_m - 0) + (0 - Y_n * N_m) := by rw [h6, h3, h4]
      _ = 0 := by abel
  refine ⟨hCommNp, hCommNm, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, hAntiNp, hAntiNm, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hA61.2.2.2.2.2.2.1, hGp1, smul_zero]
  · rw [hA61.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1, hGm1, smul_zero]
  · rw [hA61.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1, hGp2, smul_zero]
  · rw [hA61.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1, hGm2, smul_zero]
  · rw [hA61.2.2.2.2.2.1, hG0]
  · calc anticomm (genPhi P_k A C) Sig_kn

      _ = anticomm N_p Sig_kn - anticomm N_m Sig_kn := by
        unfold anticomm genJ; change (N_p - N_m) * Sig_kn + Sig_kn * (N_p - N_m) = _

theorem archetype_A67_all_scale_chiral_defect_leech_and_mog24_isolation
    {P : B} (hP : P * P = P) (A C : B) (k n : ℕ) :
    let P_k := daughterIdemTower k P A

    derivSqJ P_k A C Sig_kn = -((4 : ℤ) • (V_k * Sig_kn)) ∧

    -- 3. Pure `mog24Sig` Channel Isolation of `Σ_{k, n}`:
    hProjV P_k A C Sig_kn = 0 ∧
    hProjPhi P_k A C Sig_kn = 0 ∧
    hProjJ P_k A C Sig_kn = 0 ∧

  intro P_k V_k Sig_kn

  rcases archetype_A66_all_scale_cone_sheet_braiding_and_leech_24_sector_isolation hP A C k n with
    ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, _, hAntiNp, hAntiNm, hAntiPhi, hAntiJ⟩
  set N_p := conePlus P_k A
  set N_m := coneMinus P_k C
  have hNpSq : N_p * N_p = 0 := by dsimp [N_p]; peirce_abel_golay hPk
  have hNmSq : N_m * N_m = 0 := by dsimp [N_m]; peirce_abel_golay hPk
  have hNpS : N_p * Sig_kn = -(Sig_kn * N_p) := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hAntiNp
  have hNmS : N_m * Sig_kn = -(Sig_kn * N_m) := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hAntiNm
  have hGp2 : kantorGp2 P_k A Sig_kn = 0 := by
    unfold kantorGp2; change (N_p * Sig_kn) * N_p = 0
    rw [hNpS, neg_mul, mul_assoc, hNpSq, mul_zero, neg_zero]
  have hGm2 : kantorGm2 P_k C Sig_kn = 0 := by
    unfold kantorGm2; change (N_m * Sig_kn) * N_m = 0
    rw [hNmS, neg_mul, mul_assoc, hNmSq, mul_zero, neg_zero]
  -- Also prove that `V_k` and `Σ_k` commute with `Sig_kn`:
  have hVSig_comm : V_k * Sig_kn = Sig_kn * V_k := by
    change (N_p * N_m + N_m * N_p) * Sig_kn = Sig_kn * (N_p * N_m + N_m * N_p)
    calc (N_p * N_m + N_m * N_p) * Sig_kn
      _ = N_p * (N_m * Sig_kn) + N_m * (N_p * Sig_kn) := by rw [add_mul, mul_assoc, mul_assoc]
      _ = N_p * -(Sig_kn * N_m) + N_m * -(Sig_kn * N_p) := by rw [hNmS, hNpS]
      _ = -((N_p * Sig_kn) * N_m) - (N_m * Sig_kn) * N_p := by
          simp only [mul_neg, mul_assoc]; abel
      _ = -(-(Sig_kn * N_p) * N_m) - -(Sig_kn * N_m) * N_p := by rw [hNpS, hNmS]
      _ = Sig_kn * (N_p * N_m + N_m * N_p) := by
          simp only [neg_mul, neg_neg, mul_add, mul_assoc]; abel
  have hSigSig_comm : comm (genSig P_k A C) Sig_kn = 0 := by
    unfold comm genSig
    change (N_p * N_m - N_m * N_p) * Sig_kn - Sig_kn * (N_p * N_m - N_m * N_p) = 0
    calc (N_p * N_m - N_m * N_p) * Sig_kn - Sig_kn * (N_p * N_m - N_m * N_p)
      _ = N_p * (N_m * Sig_kn) - N_m * (N_p * Sig_kn) - Sig_kn * (N_p * N_m - N_m * N_p) := by
          rw [sub_mul, mul_assoc, mul_assoc]
      _ = N_p * -(Sig_kn * N_m) - N_m * -(Sig_kn * N_p) - Sig_kn * (N_p * N_m - N_m * N_p) := by

          simp only [mul_neg, mul_assoc]; abel
      _ = -(-(Sig_kn * N_p) * N_m) + -(Sig_kn * N_m) * N_p - Sig_kn * (N_p * N_m - N_m * N_p) := by
          rw [hNpS, hNmS]
      _ = 0 := by simp only [neg_mul, neg_neg, mul_sub, mul_assoc]; abel
  have hG0 : kantorG0 P_k A C Sig_kn = -(V_k * Sig_kn) := by
    unfold kantorG0 kantorTriple
    change (N_p * Sig_kn) * N_m + (N_m * Sig_kn) * N_p = -(V_k * Sig_kn)
    calc (N_p * Sig_kn) * N_m + (N_m * Sig_kn) * N_p
      _ = -(Sig_kn * N_p) * N_m + -(Sig_kn * N_m) * N_p := by rw [hNpS, hNmS]
      _ = -(Sig_kn * (N_p * N_m + N_m * N_p)) := by
          simp only [neg_mul, mul_add, mul_assoc]; abel
      _ = -(Sig_kn * V_k) := rfl
      _ = -(V_k * Sig_kn) := by rw [hVSig_comm]
  have hA61 := archetype_A61_golay_12_and_leech_24_operator_error_correcting_codes hPk A C Sig_kn
  -- Evaluate `derivSqPhi`, `derivSqJ`, and `derivSqSig` on `Sig_kn`:
  have hPhiSq : genPhi P_k A C * genPhi P_k A C = V_k := by
    dsimp [V_k]; peirce_abel_golay hPk
  have hJSq : genJ P_k A C * genJ P_k A C = -V_k := by
    dsimp [V_k]; peirce_abel_golay hPk
  have hPhiS : Sig_kn * genPhi P_k A C = -(genPhi P_k A C * Sig_kn) :=
    eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right hAntiPhi
  have hJS : Sig_kn * genJ P_k A C = -(genJ P_k A C * Sig_kn) :=
    eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right hAntiJ
  have hM_Phi : derivSqPhi P_k A C Sig_kn = -((4 : ℤ) • (V_k * Sig_kn)) := by

           (genPhi P_k A C * Sig_kn - Sig_kn * genPhi P_k A C) * genPhi P_k A C)

          rw [hPhiSq, hSand, ← hVSig_comm]

  have hM_J : derivSqJ P_k A C Sig_kn = -((4 : ℤ) • (V_k * Sig_kn)) := by

    have hSand : genJ P_k A C * Sig_kn * genJ P_k A C = V_k * Sig_kn := by

/-!
# Archetype A₆₈: Forward & Backward Waves (`N_+`, `N_-`), Horizon Diffusion (`D_diff`),
# and Phase-Conjugate Focusing (`Ψ_focus`) Across All Fractal Scales `(k, n) ∈ ℕ × ℕ`
# Proving That:
# 1. Pure Diffusion `D_diff(X) = 2 Φ_diff(X) - {V, X}` Damps Both `Φ` and `J` at Rate `-2 V`,
# 2. Focusing `2 Ψ_focus(X)` Contributes `+2 V` on `Φ` (Canceling Diffusion: `-2 V + 2 V = 0`,

# 3. Across All Fractal Scales `(k, n) ∈ ℕ × ℕ`, the Fractal-Modulated Wave `Φ_k * V_{k, n}`
#    Is Focused into an Exact Zero-Dissipation Soliton (`M_{Φ_k}(Φ_k * V_{k, n}) = 0`) While

namespace CanonicalNonCommutativeMasterSpine

variable {B : Type*} [Ring B]

-- (Appending directly to Archetypes A₆₃–A₆₇ in CanonicalNonCommutativeMasterSpine)

/-- **Pure Horizon Diffusion Superoperator (`diffusionOp P A C X`):**
`D_diff(X) = 2 • sandwichCross(X) - {V, X} = -([N_+, [N_-, X]] + [N_-, [N_+, X]])`. -/
def diffusionOp (P A C X : B) : B :=
  (2 : ℤ) • sandwichCross P A C X - anticomm (genV P A C) X

/-- **Phase-Conjugate Focusing Mirror (`focusingOp P A C X`):**
`Ψ_focus(X) = sandwichSame(X) = N_+ X N_+ + N_- X N_- = G_{+2}(X) + G_{-2}(X)`. -/
def focusingOp (P A C X : B) : B :=
  sandwichSame P A C X

/-- **Theorem A₆₈.1 (The Forward–Backward Wave Diffusion vs. Focusing Soliton Balance Theorem):**
For ANY base idempotent `P * P = P`, ANY `A, C, X : B`, and ALL fractal scales `(k, n) ∈ ℕ × ℕ`,
let `P_k = daughterIdemTower k P A`, `V_k = genV P_k A C`, and `V_kn = mandelbrotTower n V_k`.
Then:
1. **Fundamental Decomposition into Diffusion ± Focusing:**
   - `derivSqPhi P A C X = diffusionOp P A C X + (2 : ℤ) • focusingOp P A C X`,
   - `derivSqJ P A C X   = diffusionOp P A C X - (2 : ℤ) • focusingOp P A C X`.
2. **Action of Pure Diffusion (`-2 V` on Both `Φ` and `J`) vs. Phase-Conjugate Focusing (`+V` on `Φ`, `-V` on `J`):**
   - `diffusionOp P A C (genPhi P A C) = -((2 : ℤ) • (genV P A C * genPhi P A C))`,
   - `diffusionOp P A C (genJ P A C)   = -((2 : ℤ) • (genV P A C * genJ P A C))`,
   - `focusingOp P A C (genPhi P A C)  = +(genV P A C * genPhi P A C)` (Constructive Focusing!),
   - `focusingOp P A C (genJ P A C)    = -(genV P A C * genJ P A C)` (Destructive Defocusing!).
3. **All-Scale `(k, n) ∈ ℕ × ℕ` Fractal Wave Packet Focusing & Defocusing:**
   For the fractal-modulated in-phase wave `Φ_k * V_{k, n}` and out-of-phase wave `J_k * V_{k, n}`:
   - **Forward–Backward Sheet Transport:**
     `Φ_k * V_{k, n} = conePlus P_k A * mandelbrotTower n (qgtMinus P_k A C) +`
     `coneMinus P_k C * mandelbrotTower n (qgtPlus P_k A C)`,
   - **Pure Diffusion Damps Both Fractal Wavepackets at `-2 V_k`:**
     `diffusionOp P_k A C (genPhi P_k A C * V_kn) = -((2 : ℤ) • (V_k * genPhi P_k A C * V_kn))` and
     `diffusionOp P_k A C (genJ P_k A C * V_kn) = -((2 : ℤ) • (V_k * genJ P_k A C * V_kn))`,
   - **Focusing Mirror Reflects `Φ_k * V_{k, n}` with `+V_k` and `J_k * V_{k, n}` with `-V_k`:**
     `focusingOp P_k A C (genPhi P_k A C * V_kn) = V_k * genPhi P_k A C * V_kn` and
     `focusingOp P_k A C (genJ P_k A C * V_kn) = -(V_k * genJ P_k A C * V_kn)`,
   - **Exact Soliton Stabilization on `Φ_k * V_{k, n}` & `-4 V_k` Gap on `J_k * V_{k, n}`:**
     `derivSqPhi P_k A C (genPhi P_k A C * V_kn) = 0` and
     `derivSqPhi P_k A C (genJ P_k A C * V_kn) = -((4 : ℤ) • (V_k * genJ P_k A C * V_kn))`! -/
theorem archetype_A68_forward_backward_diffusion_vs_focusing_soliton_balance
    {P : B} (hP : P * P = P) (A C X : B) (k n : ℕ) :
    let P_k := daughterIdemTower k P A
    let V_k := genV P_k A C
    let V_kn := mandelbrotTower n V_k
    let Φ_k := genPhi P_k A C
    let J_k := genJ P_k A C
    -- 1. Universal Decomposition `M_Φ = Diffusion + 2 • Focusing`, `M_J = Diffusion - 2 • Focusing`:
    derivSqPhi P A C X = diffusionOp P A C X + (2 : ℤ) • focusingOp P A C X ∧
    derivSqJ P A C X   = diffusionOp P A C X - (2 : ℤ) • focusingOp P A C X ∧
    -- 2. Single-Scale Diffusion (`-2 V`) vs. Focusing (`±V`):
    diffusionOp P A C (genPhi P A C) = -((2 : ℤ) • (genV P A C * genPhi P A C)) ∧
    diffusionOp P A C (genJ P A C)   = -((2 : ℤ) • (genV P A C * genJ P A C)) ∧
    focusingOp P A C (genPhi P A C)  = genV P A C * genPhi P A C ∧
    focusingOp P A C (genJ P A C)    = -(genV P A C * genJ P A C) ∧
    -- 3. All-Scale `(k, n)` Fractal Wavepacket Focusing (`M_Φ(Φ_k V_{k,n}) = 0`) vs. Defocusing (`-4 V_k`):
    focusingOp P_k A C (Φ_k * V_kn) = V_k * Φ_k * V_kn ∧
    focusingOp P_k A C (J_k * V_kn) = -(V_k * J_k * V_kn) ∧
    diffusionOp P_k A C (Φ_k * V_kn) = -((2 : ℤ) • (V_k * Φ_k * V_kn)) ∧
    diffusionOp P_k A C (J_k * V_kn) = -((2 : ℤ) • (V_k * J_k * V_kn)) ∧
    derivSqPhi P_k A C (Φ_k * V_kn) = 0 ∧
    derivSqPhi P_k A C (J_k * V_kn) = -((4 : ℤ) • (V_k * J_k * V_kn)) := by
  intro P_k V_k V_kn Φ_k J_k
  have hPk : P_k * P_k = P_k :=
    (archetype_A64_universal_all_scale_fractal_rg_and_mandelbrot_tower hP A C k 0).1.1
  rcases archetype_A66_all_scale_cone_sheet_braiding_and_leech_24_sector_isolation hP A C k n with
    ⟨hCommNp, hCommNm, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _⟩
  set N_p := conePlus P_k A
  set N_m := coneMinus P_k C
  have hNpV : N_p * V_kn = V_kn * N_p := sub_eq_zero.mp hCommNp
  have hNmV : N_m * V_kn = V_kn * N_m := sub_eq_zero.mp hCommNm
  -- Since `V_kn` commutes with `N_p` and `N_m`, it can be pulled to the far right of every operator!
  have hPullCross : ∀ Z : B,
      sandwichCross P_k A C (Z * V_kn) = sandwichCross P_k A C Z * V_kn := by
    intro Z; unfold sandwichCross
    change N_p * (Z * V_kn) * N_m + N_m * (Z * V_kn) * N_p =
           (N_p * Z * N_m + N_m * Z * N_p) * V_kn
    calc N_p * (Z * V_kn) * N_m + N_m * (Z * V_kn) * N_p
      _ = (N_p * Z) * (V_kn * N_m) + (N_m * Z) * (V_kn * N_p) := by simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = (N_p * Z) * (N_m * V_kn) + (N_m * Z) * (N_p * V_kn) := by rw [← hNmV, ← hNpV]
      _ = (N_p * Z * N_m + N_m * Z * N_p) * V_kn := by simp only [add_mul, mul_assoc]
  have hPullSame : ∀ Z : B,
      focusingOp P_k A C (Z * V_kn) = focusingOp P_k A C Z * V_kn := by
    intro Z; unfold focusingOp sandwichSame
    change N_p * (Z * V_kn) * N_p + N_m * (Z * V_kn) * N_m =
           (N_p * Z * N_p + N_m * Z * N_m) * V_kn
    calc N_p * (Z * V_kn) * N_p + N_m * (Z * V_kn) * N_m
      _ = (N_p * Z) * (V_kn * N_p) + (N_m * Z) * (V_kn * N_m) := by simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = (N_p * Z) * (N_p * V_kn) + (N_m * Z) * (N_m * V_kn) := by rw [← hNpV, ← hNmV]
      _ = (N_p * Z * N_p + N_m * Z * N_m) * V_kn := by simp only [add_mul, mul_assoc]
  have hVk_Vkn : V_k * V_kn = V_kn * V_k := by
    change (N_p * N_m + N_m * N_p) * V_kn = V_kn * (N_p * N_m + N_m * N_p)
    calc (N_p * N_m + N_m * N_p) * V_kn
      _ = N_p * (N_m * V_kn) + N_m * (N_p * V_kn) := by simp only [add_mul, mul_assoc]
      _ = (N_p * V_kn) * N_m + (N_m * V_kn) * N_p := by
          rw [← hNmV, ← hNpV]; simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = V_kn * (N_p * N_m + N_m * N_p) := by
          rw [hNpV, hNmV]; simp only [mul_add, mul_assoc]
  have hPullDiff : ∀ Z : B,
      diffusionOp P_k A C (Z * V_kn) = diffusionOp P_k A C Z * V_kn := by
    intro Z; unfold diffusionOp anticomm
    rw [hPullCross Z]
    change (2 : ℤ) • (sandwichCross P_k A C Z * V_kn) - (V_k * (Z * V_kn) + (Z * V_kn) * V_k) =
           ((2 : ℤ) • sandwichCross P_k A C Z - (V_k * Z + Z * V_k)) * V_kn
    rw [mul_assoc Z V_kn V_k, ← hVk_Vkn]
    simp only [sub_mul, add_mul, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc]
  have hDecompPhi : ∀ Z : B,
      derivSqPhi P_k A C Z = diffusionOp P_k A C Z + (2 : ℤ) • focusingOp P_k A C Z := by
    intro Z; unfold diffusionOp focusingOp; peirce_abel_golay hPk
  have hFocPhi : focusingOp P_k A C Φ_k = V_k * Φ_k := by
    unfold focusingOp; dsimp [V_k, Φ_k]; peirce_abel_golay hPk
  have hFocJ : focusingOp P_k A C J_k = -(V_k * J_k) := by
    unfold focusingOp; dsimp [V_k, J_k]; peirce_abel_golay hPk
  have hDiffPhi : diffusionOp P_k A C Φ_k = -((2 : ℤ) • (V_k * Φ_k)) := by
    unfold diffusionOp; dsimp [V_k, Φ_k]; peirce_abel_golay hPk
  have hDiffJ : diffusionOp P_k A C J_k = -((2 : ℤ) • (V_k * J_k)) := by
    unfold diffusionOp; dsimp [V_k, J_k]; peirce_abel_golay hPk
  refine ⟨by unfold diffusionOp focusingOp; peirce_abel_golay hP,
          by unfold diffusionOp focusingOp; peirce_abel_golay hP,
          by unfold diffusionOp; peirce_abel_golay hP,
          by unfold diffusionOp; peirce_abel_golay hP,
          by unfold focusingOp; peirce_abel_golay hP,
          by unfold focusingOp; peirce_abel_golay hP,
          ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hPullSame Φ_k, hFocPhi]
  · rw [hPullSame J_k, hFocJ, neg_mul]
  · rw [hPullDiff Φ_k, hDiffPhi, neg_mul, smul_mul_assoc]
  · rw [hPullDiff J_k, hDiffJ, neg_mul, smul_mul_assoc]
  · rw [hDecompPhi (Φ_k * V_kn), hPullDiff Φ_k, hPullSame Φ_k,
        hDiffPhi, hFocPhi, neg_mul, smul_mul_assoc, neg_add_cancel]
  · rw [hDecompPhi (J_k * V_kn), hPullDiff J_k, hPullSame J_k,
        hDiffJ, hFocJ, neg_mul, neg_mul, smul_mul_assoc, smul_neg]

theorem archetype_A68_single_sheet_leech_swap_and_golay_12_24_projections
    {P : B} (hP : P * P = P) (A C : B) (k n : ℕ) :
    let P_k := daughterIdemTower k P A

    let Sig_kn := chiralFractalBranch n P_k A C
    -- 1. Chiral Parity Eigenvalues & Single-Sheet Annihilators:
    Sig_k * X_n = V_k * X_n ∧
    Sig_k * Y_n = -(V_k * Y_n) ∧
    (V_k - Sig_k) * X_n = 0 ∧

    mog24V P_k A C X_n = (12 : ℤ) • ((V_k * V_k) * V_kn) ∧

  rcases cone_sheet_braiding_all_scales hP A C k n with ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6⟩
  set N_p := conePlus P_k A

  have hSig_Y : Sig_k * Y_n = -(V_k * Y_n) := by

  -- 2. Grade-0 Kantor & Leech Mirror Sheet-Swap `X_n ↔ Y_n`:
  have hG0_X : kantorG0 P_k A C X_n = V_k * Y_n := by

      _ = N_p * (N_m * Y_n) + N_m * (N_p * Y_n) := by rw [zero_mul, h3, mul_zero, ← h5]

      _ = N_p * (N_m * X_n) + N_m * (N_p * X_n) := by rw [zero_mul, h1, mul_zero, ← h6]

  have hA61_X := archetype_A61_golay_12_and_leech_24_operator_error_correcting_codes hPk A C X_n
  have hA61_Y := archetype_A61_golay_12_and_leech_24_operator_error_correcting_codes hPk A C Y_n
  -- 3. Commutation of `V_k` and `Sig_k` with `X_n`, and `derivSq` on `X_n`:
  have hVX_comm : V_k * X_n = X_n * V_k := by
    change (N_p * N_m + N_m * N_p) * X_n = X_n * (N_p * N_m + N_m * N_p)

      _ = N_p * (Y_n * N_m) + 0 := by rw [h6, h1, mul_zero]
      _ = (N_p * Y_n) * N_m := by rw [add_zero, mul_assoc]
      _ = (X_n * N_p) * N_m + (X_n * N_m) * N_p := by rw [h5, h4, zero_mul, add_zero]
      _ = X_n * (N_p * N_m + N_m * N_p) := by simp only [mul_add, mul_assoc]
  have hSigX_comm : comm Sig_k X_n = 0 := by

  have hJXJ : genJ P_k A C * X_n * genJ P_k A C = -(V_k * Y_n) := by

          simp only [sub_mul, mul_sub]; abel
      _ = 0 - 0 - (N_m * X_n) * N_p + N_m * (X_n * N_m) := by
          rw [h1, zero_mul, mul_assoc]
      _ = -((N_p * X_n) * N_m + (N_m * X_n) * N_p) := by

  have hM_Phi : derivSqPhi P_k A C X_n = -((2 : ℤ) • (V_k * X_n - V_k * Y_n)) := by

           (genPhi P_k A C * X_n - X_n * genPhi P_k A C) * genPhi P_k A C)

            genPhi P_k A C * X_n * genPhi P_k A C +
            X_n * (genPhi P_k A C * genPhi P_k A C)) := by
          simp only [mul_sub, sub_mul, mul_assoc]; abel
      _ = -(V_k * X_n - V_k * Y_n - V_k * Y_n + V_k * X_n) := by
          rw [hPhiSq, hPhiXPhi, ← hVX_comm]
      _ = -((2 : ℤ) • (V_k * X_n - V_k * Y_n)) := by abel
  have hM_J : derivSqJ P_k A C X_n = -((2 : ℤ) • (V_k * X_n - V_k * Y_n)) := by

         (genJ P_k A C * X_n - X_n * genJ P_k A C) * genJ P_k A C

          genJ P_k A C * X_n * genJ P_k A C +
          X_n * (genJ P_k A C * genJ P_k A C) := by

      _ = (-V_k) * X_n - -(V_k * Y_n) - -(V_k * Y_n) + X_n * (-V_k) := by

      _ = -(V_k * X_n) + V_k * Y_n + V_k * Y_n - V_k * X_n := by

      _ = -((2 : ℤ) • (V_k * X_n - V_k * Y_n)) := by abel
  have hM_Sig : derivSqSig P_k A C X_n = 0 := by

  refine ⟨hSig_X, hSig_Y, hAnn_X, hAnn_Y, ?_, ?_, hMogV_X, hMogSig_X, ?_, ?_⟩

  · rw [hMogV_X, hMogSig_X, hSplit]

/-- **Theorem A₆₉.1 (All-Scale `(k, n) ∈ ℕ × ℕ` Single-Sheet Erasure Recovery & Sheet Separation):**

   - And both decoders annihilate all off-diagonal bit-flip (`Φ_k`) and phase-flip (`J_k`) errors! -/

    {P : B} (hP : P * P = P) (A C : B) (k n : ℕ) :
    let P_k := daughterIdemTower k P A
    let V_k := genV P_k A C
    let Sig_k := genSig P_k A C
    let X_n := mandelbrotTower n (qgtPlus P_k A C)
    let Y_n := mandelbrotTower n (qgtMinus P_k A C)
    let V_kn := mandelbrotTower n V_k
    let Sig_kn := chiralFractalBranch n P_k A C
    -- 1. Chiral Parity Swap `Sig_k * Sig_kn = V_k * V_kn` and `Sig_k * V_kn = V_k * Sig_kn`:
    Sig_k * Sig_kn = V_k * V_kn ∧
    Sig_k * V_kn = V_k * Sig_kn ∧
    -- 2. Scale-12 Half-Projections on the Lower Sheet `Y_n`:
    mog24V P_k A C Y_n = (12 : ℤ) • ((V_k * V_k) * V_kn) ∧
    mog24Sig P_k A C Y_n = -((12 : ℤ) • ((V_k * V_k) * Sig_kn)) ∧
    -- 3. All-Scale Single-Sheet Erasure Recovery (`X_n ↦ 24 V_k³ V_{k,n}`, `Y_n ↦ 0` and Dual):
    mog24SheetPlus P_k A C X_n = (24 : ℤ) • ((V_k * V_k * V_k) * V_kn) ∧
    mog24SheetPlus P_k A C Y_n = 0 ∧
    mog24SheetMinus P_k A C X_n = 0 ∧
    mog24SheetMinus P_k A C Y_n = (24 : ℤ) • ((V_k * V_k * V_k) * V_kn) := by
  intro P_k V_k Sig_k X_n Y_n V_kn Sig_kn
  have hQuad := archetype_A64_universal_all_scale_fractal_rg_and_mandelbrot_tower hP A C k n
  have hPk : P_k * P_k = P_k := hQuad.1.1
  have hSplit : V_kn = X_n + Y_n := hQuad.2.1
  rcases archetype_A68_single_sheet_leech_swap_and_golay_12_24_projections hP A C k n with
    ⟨hSig_X, hSig_Y, _, _, _, _, hMogV_X, hMogSig_X, _, _⟩
  rcases archetype_A65_all_scale_fractal_codeword_error_immunity hP A C k n with

  rcases archetype_A67_all_scale_chiral_defect_leech_and_mog24_isolation hP A C k n with

    unfold mog24Sig
    rw [(archetype_A65_all_scale_fractal_codeword_error_immunity hP A C k n).2.2.2.2.2.1,

  have hMogV_S : mog24V P_k A C Sig_kn = 0 := by

    change Sig_k * (X_n - Y_n) = V_k * V_kn
    rw [mul_sub, hSig_X, hSig_Y, sub_neg_eq_add, ← mul_add, ← hSplit]
  have hSwap2 : Sig_k * V_kn = V_k * Sig_kn := by

    unfold Sig_kn chiralFractalBranch
    change V_k * X_n + -(V_k * Y_n) = V_k * (X_n - Y_n)
    rw [mul_sub, sub_eq_add_neg]
  -- 2. Linearity of `mog24V` and `mog24Sig` on `V_kn = X_n + Y_n` gives `mog24V Y_n` and `mog24Sig Y_n`:
  have hLinV : mog24V P_k A C (X_n + Y_n) = mog24V P_k A C X_n + mog24V P_k A C Y_n := by
    unfold mog24V hProjV derivSqPhi derivSqJ derivSqSig comm
    simp only [mul_add, add_mul, sub_mul, mul_sub, neg_add_rev, smul_add]; abel
  have hLinSig : mog24Sig P_k A C (X_n + Y_n) = mog24Sig P_k A C X_n + mog24Sig P_k A C Y_n := by
    unfold mog24Sig hProjSig derivSqPhi derivSqJ derivSqSig comm

  have hMogV_Y : mog24V P_k A C Y_n = (12 : ℤ) • ((V_k * V_k) * V_kn) := by
    have hSum := hMogV_V

  have hSigTriple : Sig_k * ((V_k * V_k) * Sig_kn) = (V_k * V_k * V_k) * V_kn := by

      _ = V_k * (Sig_k * V_k) * Sig_kn := by rw [hSigV_comm, mul_assoc]
      _ = (V_k * V_k) * (Sig_k * Sig_kn) := by rw [hSigV_comm]; simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = (V_k * V_k * V_k) * V_kn := by rw [hSwap1]; simp only [mul_assoc]
  refine ⟨hSwap1, hSwap2, hMogV_Y, hMogSig_Y, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · unfold mog24SheetPlus
    change V_k * mog24V P_k A C X_n + Sig_k * mog24Sig P_k A C X_n = _

theorem archetype_A75_multi_depth_cross_sheet_orthogonality_and_graded_codeword_algebra
    {P : B} (hP : P * P = P) (A C : B) (k n m : ℕ) :
    let P_k := daughterIdemTower k P A

      _ = 0 := by rw [hPm_Y, mul_zero]
  have hYX_nm : Y_n * X_m = 0 := by
    calc Y_n * X_m
      _ = (Y_n * (1 - P_k)) * X_m := by rw [hYn_R]

      _ = 0 := by rw [hQm_X, mul_zero]
  -- 2. Deduce the Multi-Depth Graded Multiplication Table:
  have hVV : V_kn * V_km = X_n * X_m + Y_n * Y_m := by
    rw [hSplit_n, hSplit_m]
    simp only [add_mul, mul_add, hXY_nm, hYX_nm, add_zero, zero_add]
  have hSS : Sig_kn * Sig_km = V_kn * V_km := by
    rw [hVV]
    unfold Sig_kn Sig_km chiralFractalBranch
    change (X_n - Y_n) * (X_m - Y_m) = X_n * X_m + Y_n * Y_m
    simp only [sub_mul, mul_sub, hXY_nm, hYX_nm, sub_zero, zero_sub, sub_neg_eq_add]
  have hSV : Sig_kn * V_km = X_n * X_m - Y_n * Y_m := by
    rw [hSplit_m]
    unfold Sig_kn chiralFractalBranch
    change (X_n - Y_n) * (X_m + Y_m) = X_n * X_m - Y_n * Y_m
    simp only [sub_mul, mul_add, hXY_nm, hYX_nm, add_zero, zero_add]
  have hVS : V_kn * Sig_km = Sig_kn * V_km := by

  -- 3. Fault-Tolerant Invariance of `Sig_kn * Sig_km = V_kn * V_km`:
  rcases archetype_A73_steinberg_yang_baxter_defect_chebyshev_trace_and_all_scale_invariance hP A C k n with
    ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, _, hMoeb_n, _, hStein_n, _, _⟩

/-- **Algebraic Ket `|ψ_A⟩ = conePlus P A = P * A * (1 - P)`:** -/
def diracKet (P A : B) : B := conePlus P A

/-- **Algebraic Bra `⟨ψ_A| = coneMinus P (star A) = (1 - P) * star A * P`:** -/
def diracBra (P A : B) : B := coneMinus P (star A)

    idemDefect (P_k1 * idemTransv P_k C * P_k1) = mandelbrotTower 0 V_k * P_k1 ∧
    -- 2. All-Scale Ideal Isolation of the Self-Dual (`X_n`) and Anti-Self-Dual (`Y_n`) Fractal Sheets:
    ketIdeal P_k V_kn = X_n ∧
    braIdeal P_k V_kn = X_n ∧
    ketIdeal (1 - P_k) V_kn = Y_n ∧
    braIdeal (1 - P_k) V_kn = Y_n ∧
    -- 3. All-Scale Bra/Ket Separation into Forward Particle (`N_{+,k} V_{k,n}`) & Backward Hole (`N_{-,k} V_{k,n}`):
    braIdeal P_k (Φ_k * V_kn) = conePlus P_k A * V_kn ∧
    ketIdeal P_k (Φ_k * V_kn) = coneMinus P_k C * V_kn ∧
    braIdeal P_k (Φ_k * V_kn) + ketIdeal P_k (Φ_k * V_kn) = Φ_k * V_kn ∧
    braIdeal P_k (Φ_k * V_kn) - ketIdeal P_k (Φ_k * V_kn) = J_k * V_kn ∧
    braIdeal P_k (Φ_k * V_kn) * ketIdeal P_k (Φ_k * V_kn) +
      ketIdeal P_k (Φ_k * V_kn) * braIdeal P_k (Φ_k * V_kn) = V_k * (V_kn * V_kn) := by
  intro P_k P_k1 V_k Φ_k J_k X_n Y_n V_kn
  have hQuad := archetype_A64_universal_all_scale_fractal_rg_and_mandelbrot_tower hP A C k n
  have hPk : P_k * P_k = P_k := hQuad.1.1
  have hSplit : V_kn = X_n + Y_n := hQuad.2.1
  rcases archetype_A66_all_scale_cone_sheet_braiding_and_leech_24_sector_isolation hP A C k n with
    ⟨hCommNp, hCommNm, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _⟩
  rcases archetype_A72_andreev_multipass_mandelbrot_defect_and_all_scale_sheet_confinement hP A C k n with
    ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, hPY_L, hPY_R, _, _, _⟩
  rcases archetype_A74_all_scale_fractal_instanton_self_duality_and_hodge_star_swap hP A C k n with
    ⟨hPX_L, hPX_R, hQY_L, hQY_R, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _⟩
  set N_p := conePlus P_k A
  set N_m := coneMinus P_k C
  have hNpV : N_p * V_kn = V_kn * N_p := sub_eq_zero.mp hCommNp
  have hNmV : N_m * V_kn = V_kn * N_m := sub_eq_zero.mp hCommNm
  -- 2. Even codeword projections:
  have hKetP_V : ketIdeal P_k V_kn = X_n := by
    unfold ketIdeal; rw [hSplit, add_mul, hPX_R, hPY_R, add_zero]
  have hBraP_V : braIdeal P_k V_kn = X_n := by
    unfold braIdeal; rw [hSplit, mul_add, hPX_L, hPY_L, add_zero]
  have hKetQ_V : ketIdeal (1 - P_k) V_kn = Y_n := by
    unfold ketIdeal
    have hXQ_R : X_n * (1 - P_k) = 0 := by rw [mul_sub, mul_one, hPX_R, sub_self]
    rw [hSplit, add_mul, hXQ_R, hQY_R, zero_add]
  have hBraQ_V : braIdeal (1 - P_k) V_kn = Y_n := by
    unfold braIdeal
    have hQX_L : (1 - P_k) * X_n = 0 := by rw [sub_mul, one_mul, hPX_L, sub_self]
    rw [hSplit, mul_add, hQX_L, hQY_L, zero_add]
  -- 3. Odd pilot-wave Bra/Ket projections:
  have hPPhi : P_k * Φ_k = N_p := by dsimp [Φ_k, N_p]; peirce_abel_golay hPk
  have hPhiP : Φ_k * P_k = N_m := by dsimp [Φ_k, N_m]; peirce_abel_golay hPk
  have hPkV_comm : P_k * V_kn = V_kn * P_k := by
    rw [← hBraP_V, ← hKetP_V]
  have hBraPhiV : braIdeal P_k (Φ_k * V_kn) = N_p * V_kn := by
    unfold braIdeal; rw [← mul_assoc, hPPhi]
  have hKetPhiV : ketIdeal P_k (Φ_k * V_kn) = N_m * V_kn := by
    unfold ketIdeal; rw [mul_assoc, ← hPkV_comm, ← mul_assoc, hPhiP]
  refine ⟨by dsimp [P_k1, daughterIdemTower]; peirce_abel_golay hPk,
          by dsimp [P_k1, daughterIdemTower]; peirce_abel_golay hPk,
          by dsimp [P_k1, daughterIdemTower, V_k]; peirce_abel_golay hPk,
          by dsimp [P_k1, daughterIdemTower, mandelbrotTower, V_k]; peirce_abel_golay hPk,
          hKetP_V, hBraP_V, hKetQ_V, hBraQ_V,
          hBraPhiV, hKetPhiV, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hBraPhiV, hKetPhiV]
    change N_p * V_kn + N_m * V_kn = (N_p + N_m) * V_kn
    rw [add_mul]
  · rw [hBraPhiV, hKetPhiV]
    change N_p * V_kn - N_m * V_kn = (N_p - N_m) * V_kn
    rw [sub_mul]
  · rw [hBraPhiV, hKetPhiV]
    change (N_p * V_kn) * (N_m * V_kn) + (N_m * V_kn) * (N_p * V_kn) =
           (N_p * N_m + N_m * N_p) * (V_kn * V_kn)
    calc (N_p * V_kn) * (N_m * V_kn) + (N_m * V_kn) * (N_p * V_kn)
      _ = N_p * (V_kn * N_m) * V_kn + N_m * (V_kn * N_p) * V_kn := by simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = N_p * (N_m * V_kn) * V_kn + N_m * (N_p * V_kn) * V_kn := by rw [← hNmV, ← hNpV]
      _ = (N_p * N_m + N_m * N_p) * (V_kn * V_kn) := by simp only [add_mul, mul_assoc]

end CanonicalNonCommutativeMasterSpine

/-! ### Archetype A₈₁: Dirac–Krein Chart Duality, Bruhat Transitivity & Two-State Sandwich `P_A X P_C` -/

/-- **Theorem A₈₁.1 (Dirac–Krein Chart Duality, Möbius–Bruhat Orbit & Two-State Sandwich `P_A X P_C`):**
For ANY self-adjoint idempotent `P : B` (`hP : P * P = P`, `hPsym : star P = P`) and ANY `A, C, X : B`:
1. **Dirac–Krein Adjoint Duality Between `P_A ∈ P B` and `P_{A^⋆} ∈ B P` & Complementary Krein Norm:**
   - `diracKreinAdj P (idemTrans P A) = idemTransv P (star A)` (`(P_A)^# = P_{A^⋆}`!),
   - `diracKreinAdj P (idemTransv P C) = idemTrans P (star C)` (`(P_C)^# = P_{C^⋆}`!),
   - On the complementary anti-vacuum left ideal `B(1 - P)`:
     `diracKreinAdj P (ketIdealComp P X) * ketIdealComp P X =`
     `peirce00 P (star X) * peirce00 P X - qgtMinus P X (star X)`.
2. **Transitive Action of the Unipotent and Möbius–Bruhat Groups on `P, P_A, P_C`:**
   - `conjPlus P A P = idemTrans P A` and `conjMinus P C P = idemTransv P C`,
   - `moebiusConj P A C (idemTransv P C) = idemTrans P A` (`g_Bruhat` maps `P_C ∈ B P` to `P_A ∈ P B`!),
   - `moebiusConjDual P A C (idemTrans P A) = idemTransv P C` (`g_Bruhat,dual` maps `P_A` to `P_C`!).
3. **Aharonov–Bergmann–Lebowitz / Hua Two-State Sandwich `P_A * G * P_C` on `(Φ, J, V, Σ)`:**
   - `idemTrans P A * genPhi P A C * idemTransv P C = 0` (Exact destructive cancellation on `Φ`!),
   - `idemTrans P A * genJ P A C * idemTransv P C = (2 : ℤ) • qgtPlus P A C` (Constructive QGT on `J`!),
   - `idemTrans P A * genV P A C * idemTransv P C = -idemDefect (qgtPlus P A C)` (`= Q_+ - Q_+²`),
   - `idemTrans P A * genSig P A C * idemTransv P C = -idemDefect (qgtPlus P A C)` (`= Q_+ - Q_+²`).
4. **Klein Four-Group `V₄` Raising/Lowering Selection Rules on `P_C ∈ B P` and `P_A ∈ P B`:**
   - `(genPhi P A C + genJ P A C) * idemTransv P C = (2 : ℤ) • qgtPlus P A C`,
   - `(genPhi P A C - genJ P A C) * idemTransv P C = (2 : ℤ) • coneMinus P C`,
   - `idemTrans P A * (genPhi P A C - genJ P A C) = -((2 : ℤ) • qgtPlus P A C)`,
   - `idemTrans P A * (genPhi P A C + genJ P A C) = -((2 : ℤ) • conePlus P A)`! -/
theorem archetype_A81_dirac_krein_chart_duality_bruhat_orbit_and_two_state_weak_sandwich
    {P : B} (hP : P * P = P) (hPsym : star P = P) (A C X : B) :
    -- 1. Dirac–Krein Chart Duality `(P_A)^# = P_{A^⋆}` & Complementary Spinor Norm on `B(1 - P)`:
    diracKreinAdj P (idemTrans P A) = idemTransv P (star A) ∧
    diracKreinAdj P (idemTransv P C) = idemTrans P (star C) ∧
    diracKreinAdj P (ketIdealComp P X) * ketIdealComp P X =
      peirce00 P (star X) * peirce00 P X - qgtMinus P X (star X) ∧
    -- 2. Unipotent & Möbius–Bruhat Transitive Action on `P, P_A, P_C`:
    conjPlus P A P = idemTrans P A ∧
    conjMinus P C P = idemTransv P C ∧
    moebiusConj P A C (idemTransv P C) = idemTrans P A ∧
    moebiusConjDual P A C (idemTrans P A) = idemTransv P C ∧
    -- 3. Two-State Projective Sandwich `P_A * G * P_C` on the Tetraktys `(Φ, J, V, Σ)`:
    idemTrans P A * genPhi P A C * idemTransv P C = 0 ∧
    idemTrans P A * genJ P A C * idemTransv P C = (2 : ℤ) • qgtPlus P A C ∧
    idemTrans P A * genV P A C * idemTransv P C = -idemDefect (qgtPlus P A C) ∧
    idemTrans P A * genSig P A C * idemTransv P C = -idemDefect (qgtPlus P A C) ∧
    -- 4. Klein `V₄` Selection Rules on `P_C ∈ B P` and `P_A ∈ P B`:
    (genPhi P A C + genJ P A C) * idemTransv P C = (2 : ℤ) • qgtPlus P A C ∧
    (genPhi P A C - genJ P A C) * idemTransv P C = (2 : ℤ) • coneMinus P C ∧
    idemTrans P A * (genPhi P A C - genJ P A C) = -((2 : ℤ) • qgtPlus P A C) ∧
    idemTrans P A * (genPhi P A C + genJ P A C) = -((2 : ℤ) • conePlus P A) := by
  refine ⟨by unfold diracKreinAdj idemTrans idemTransv conePlus coneMinus
             simp only [star_sub, star_mul, star_one, hPsym]; peirce_abel_golay hP,
          by unfold diracKreinAdj idemTrans idemTransv conePlus coneMinus
             simp only [star_add, star_sub, star_mul, star_one, hPsym]; peirce_abel_golay hP,
          by unfold diracKreinAdj ketIdealComp
             simp only [star_mul, star_sub, star_one, hPsym]; peirce_abel_golay hP,
          by peirce_abel_golay hP,
          by peirce_abel_golay hP,
          by peirce_abel_golay hP,
          by unfold moebiusConjDual moebiusBruhatDual moebiusBruhatDualInv; peirce_abel_golay hP,
          by peirce_abel_golay hP,
          by peirce_abel_golay hP,
          by peirce_abel_golay hP,
          by peirce_abel_golay hP,
          by peirce_abel_golay hP,
          by peirce_abel_golay hP,
          by peirce_abel_golay hP,
          by peirce_abel_golay hP⟩

/-! ### Archetype A₈₂: All-Scale `(k, n) ∈ ℕ × ℕ` Two-State Transition Sandwich on the Fractal Tetraktys -/

/-- **Theorem A₈₂.1 (All-Scale `(k, n) ∈ ℕ × ℕ` Two-State Projective Sandwich & Bruhat Chart Link):**
For ANY base idempotent `P * P = P`, ANY `A, C : B`, and ALL fractal scales `(k, n) ∈ ℕ × ℕ`,
let `P_k = daughterIdemTower k P A`, `P_{k+1} = daughterIdemTower (k + 1) P A = idemTrans P_k A`,
`P_{C,k} = idemTransv P_k C`, `V_k = genV P_k A C`, `Φ_k = genPhi P_k A C`, `J_k = genJ P_k A C`,
`X_n = mandelbrotTower n (qgtPlus P_k A C)`, `V_kn = mandelbrotTower n V_k`,
and `Sig_kn = chiralFractalBranch n P_k A C`. Then:
1. **All-Scale Möbius–Bruhat Link Between `P_{C, k} ∈ B P_k` and the Next RG Site `P_{k+1} ∈ P_k B`:**
   - `moebiusConj P_k A C P_{C, k} = P_{k+1}`,
   - `moebiusConjDual P_k A C P_{k+1} = P_{C, k}`.
2. **All-Scale Two-State Projective Transition Sandwich `P_{k+1} * Z * P_{C, k}` on the Fractal Tetraktys:**
   - **Pilot Wave Orthogonality (`= 0`):**
     `P_{k+1} * (Φ_k * V_kn) * P_{C, k} = 0`,
   - **Phase Current Constructive QGT Transfer (`= 2 Q_{+,k} X_n`):**
     `P_{k+1} * (J_k * V_kn) * P_{C, k} = (2 : ℤ) • (qgtPlus P_k A C * X_n)`,
   - **Even Codeword & Chiral Defect Euler–Bergman Compression (`= (1 - V_k) X_n`):**
     `P_{k+1} * V_kn * P_{C, k} = eulerInv P_k A C * X_n` and
     `P_{k+1} * Sig_kn * P_{C, k} = eulerInv P_k A C * X_n`! -/
theorem archetype_A82_all_scale_two_state_projective_sandwich_and_bruhat_rg_link
    {P : B} (hP : P * P = P) (A C : B) (k n : ℕ) :
    let P_k := daughterIdemTower k P A
    let P_k1 := daughterIdemTower (k + 1) P A
    let P_Ck := idemTransv P_k C
    let V_k := genV P_k A C
    let Φ_k := genPhi P_k A C
    let J_k := genJ P_k A C
    let X_n := mandelbrotTower n (qgtPlus P_k A C)
    let V_kn := mandelbrotTower n V_k
    let Sig_kn := chiralFractalBranch n P_k A C
    -- 1. All-Scale Möbius–Bruhat Link Between `P_{C, k}` and `P_{k+1}`:
    moebiusConj P_k A C P_Ck = P_k1 ∧
    moebiusConjDual P_k A C P_k1 = P_Ck ∧
    -- 2. All-Scale Two-State Projective Sandwich on `(Φ_k V_{k,n}, J_k V_{k,n}, V_{k,n}, Σ_{k,n})`:
    P_k1 * (Φ_k * V_kn) * P_Ck = 0 ∧
    P_k1 * (J_k * V_kn) * P_Ck = (2 : ℤ) • (qgtPlus P_k A C * X_n) ∧
    P_k1 * V_kn * P_Ck = eulerInv P_k A C * X_n ∧
    P_k1 * Sig_kn * P_Ck = eulerInv P_k A C * X_n := by
  intro P_k P_k1 P_Ck V_k Φ_k J_k X_n V_kn Sig_kn
  have hQuad := archetype_A64_universal_all_scale_fractal_rg_and_mandelbrot_tower hP A C k n
  have hPk : P_k * P_k = P_k := hQuad.1.1
  have hSplit : V_kn = X_n + mandelbrotTower n (qgtMinus P_k A C) := hQuad.2.1
  rcases archetype_A66_all_scale_cone_sheet_braiding_and_leech_24_sector_isolation hP A C k n with
    ⟨_, hCommNm, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _⟩
  rcases archetype_A72_andreev_multipass_mandelbrot_defect_and_all_scale_sheet_confinement hP A C k n with
    ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, hPY_L, _, _, _, _⟩
  rcases archetype_A74_all_scale_fractal_instanton_self_duality_and_hodge_star_swap hP A C k n with
    ⟨hPX_L, hPX_R, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _⟩
  have hA80 := archetype_A80_all_scale_fractal_dirac_ideals_and_rg_chain_links hP A C k n
  set N_m := coneMinus P_k C
  set Y_n := mandelbrotTower n (qgtMinus P_k A C)
  have hNmV : N_m * V_kn = V_kn * N_m := sub_eq_zero.mp hCommNm
  have hPkV : P_k * V_kn = V_kn * P_k := by
    rw [← hA80.2.2.2.2.2.1, ← hA80.2.2.2.2.1]
  -- `V_kn` commutes with `P_Ck = P_k + N_m`:
  have hVkn_PCk : V_kn * P_Ck = P_Ck * V_kn := by
    unfold P_Ck idemTransv
    simp only [mul_add, add_mul, hPkV, hNmV]
  have hPVkn : P_k * V_kn = X_n := hA80.2.2.2.2.2.1
  have hPSig : P_k * Sig_kn = X_n := by
    unfold Sig_kn chiralFractalBranch
    rw [mul_sub, hPX_L, hPY_L, sub_zero]
  have hSigP : Sig_kn * P_k = X_n := by
    unfold Sig_kn chiralFractalBranch
    have hYP_R : Y_n * P_k = 0 :=
      (archetype_A72_andreev_multipass_mandelbrot_defect_and_all_scale_sheet_confinement
        hP A C k n).2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
    rw [sub_mul, hPX_R, hYP_R, sub_zero]
  have hPCk_eq : P_Ck * P_k = P_Ck := by
    unfold P_Ck idemTransv; peirce_abel_golay hPk
  have hPk1_eq : P_k1 * P_k = P_k := hA80.2.1
  have hPk1_PCk : P_k1 * P_Ck = eulerInv P_k A C * P_k := by
    dsimp [P_k1, daughterIdemTower, P_Ck, V_k]; peirce_abel_golay hPk
  have hBasePhi : P_k1 * Φ_k * P_Ck = 0 := by
    dsimp [P_k1, daughterIdemTower, Φ_k, P_Ck]; peirce_abel_golay hPk
  have hBaseJ : P_k1 * J_k * P_Ck = (2 : ℤ) • qgtPlus P_k A C := by
    dsimp [P_k1, daughterIdemTower, J_k, P_Ck]; peirce_abel_golay hPk
  have hQgt_P : qgtPlus P_k A C * P_k = qgtPlus P_k A C := by
    peirce_abel_golay hPk
  refine ⟨by dsimp [P_k1, daughterIdemTower, P_Ck]; peirce_abel_golay hPk,
          by unfold moebiusConjDual moebiusBruhatDual moebiusBruhatDualInv
             dsimp [P_k1, daughterIdemTower, P_Ck]; peirce_abel_golay hPk,
          ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · calc P_k1 * (Φ_k * V_kn) * P_Ck
      _ = P_k1 * Φ_k * (V_kn * P_Ck) := by simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = (P_k1 * Φ_k * P_Ck) * V_kn := by rw [hVkn_PCk]; simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = 0 := by rw [hBasePhi, zero_mul]
  · calc P_k1 * (J_k * V_kn) * P_Ck
      _ = P_k1 * J_k * (V_kn * P_Ck) := by simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = (P_k1 * J_k * P_Ck) * V_kn := by rw [hVkn_PCk]; simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = ((2 : ℤ) • qgtPlus P_k A C) * V_kn := by rw [hBaseJ]
      _ = (2 : ℤ) • ((qgtPlus P_k A C * P_k) * V_kn) := by rw [hQgt_P, smul_mul_assoc]
      _ = (2 : ℤ) • (qgtPlus P_k A C * (P_k * V_kn)) := by rw [mul_assoc]
      _ = (2 : ℤ) • (qgtPlus P_k A C * X_n) := by rw [hPVkn]
  · calc P_k1 * V_kn * P_Ck
      _ = P_k1 * (V_kn * P_Ck) := by rw [mul_assoc]
      _ = (P_k1 * P_Ck) * V_kn := by rw [hVkn_PCk, ← mul_assoc]
      _ = (eulerInv P_k A C * P_k) * V_kn := by rw [hPk1_PCk]
      _ = eulerInv P_k A C * (P_k * V_kn) := by rw [mul_assoc]
      _ = eulerInv P_k A C * X_n := by rw [hPVkn]
  · calc P_k1 * Sig_kn * P_Ck
      _ = (P_k1 * P_k) * Sig_kn * P_Ck := by
          have hP_Sig : P_k * Sig_kn = Sig_kn * P_k := by rw [hPSig, hSigP]
          rw [mul_assoc P_k1 P_k Sig_kn, hPSig, ← hSigP, ← mul_assoc, hPk1_eq, hPSig]
      _ = P_k * X_n * P_Ck := by rw [hPk1_eq, hPSig]
      _ = X_n * P_Ck := by rw [hPX_L]
      _ = (X_n * P_k) * P_Ck := by rw [hPX_R]
      _ = X_n * (P_k * P_Ck) := by rw [mul_assoc]
      _ = (P_k * V_kn) * P_k := by

namespace CanonicalNonCommutativeMasterSpine

variable {B : Type*} [Ring B]

def comm (X Y : B) : B := X * Y - Y * X
def anticomm (X Y : B) : B := X * Y + Y * X

def invS (P : B) : B := P - (1 - P)
def conePlus (P A : B) : B := P * A * (1 - P)
def coneMinus (P C : B) : B := (1 - P) * C * P

def genPhi (P A C : B) : B := conePlus P A + coneMinus P C
def genJ   (P A C : B) : B := conePlus P A - coneMinus P C
def genV   (P A C : B) : B := anticomm (conePlus P A) (coneMinus P C)
def genSig (P A C : B) : B := comm (conePlus P A) (coneMinus P C)

def qgtPlus  (P A C : B) : B := conePlus P A * coneMinus P C
def qgtMinus (P A C : B) : B := coneMinus P C * conePlus P A

lemma P_assoc {P : B} (hP : P * P = P) (X : B) : P * (P * X) = P * X := by
  rw [← mul_assoc, hP]

macro "peirce_abel_gamma5" hP:ident : tactic =>
  `(tactic| (

               add_mul, mul_add, sub_mul, mul_sub, one_mul, mul_one,

theorem archetype_A86_tetraktys_dirac_clifford_and_chiral_gamma5_duality

  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;>

universe u
variable {R : Type u}

@[ext]
structure Vec3 (R : Type u) where
  x : R
  y : R
  z : R
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

namespace Vec3
variable [Ring R]

@[simp] def zero : Vec3 R := ⟨0, 0, 0⟩
@[simp] def add (u v : Vec3 R) : Vec3 R := ⟨u.x + v.x, u.y + v.y, u.z + v.z⟩
@[simp] def neg (u : Vec3 R)   : Vec3 R := ⟨-u.x, -u.y, -u.z⟩
@[simp] def sub (u v : Vec3 R) : Vec3 R := ⟨u.x - v.x, u.y - v.y, u.z - v.z⟩

instance : Zero (Vec3 R) := ⟨zero⟩
instance : Add (Vec3 R)  := ⟨add⟩
instance : Neg (Vec3 R)  := ⟨neg⟩
instance : Sub (Vec3 R)  := ⟨sub⟩

@[simp] lemma zero_x : (0 : Vec3 R).x = 0 := rfl
@[simp] lemma zero_y : (0 : Vec3 R).y = 0 := rfl
@[simp] lemma zero_z : (0 : Vec3 R).z = 0 := rfl
@[simp] lemma add_x (u v : Vec3 R) : (u + v).x = u.x + v.x := rfl
@[simp] lemma add_y (u v : Vec3 R) : (u + v).y = u.y + v.y := rfl
@[simp] lemma add_z (u v : Vec3 R) : (u + v).z = u.z + v.z := rfl
@[simp] lemma neg_x (u : Vec3 R) : (-u).x = -u.x := rfl
@[simp] lemma neg_y (u : Vec3 R) : (-u).y = -u.y := rfl
@[simp] lemma neg_z (u : Vec3 R) : (-u).z = -u.z := rfl
@[simp] lemma sub_x (u v : Vec3 R) : (u - v).x = u.x - v.x := rfl
@[simp] lemma sub_y (u v : Vec3 R) : (u - v).y = u.y - v.y := rfl
@[simp] lemma sub_z (u v : Vec3 R) : (u - v).z = u.z - v.z := rfl

@[simp] def smulLeft (a : R) (u : Vec3 R) : Vec3 R := ⟨a * u.x, a * u.y, a * u.z⟩
@[simp] def smulRight (u : Vec3 R) (d : R) : Vec3 R := ⟨u.x * d, u.y * d, u.z * d⟩
@[simp] def dot (u v : Vec3 R) : R := u.x * v.x + u.y * v.y + u.z * v.z

@[simp] def cross (u v : Vec3 R) : Vec3 R :=
  ⟨ u.y * v.z - u.z * v.y,
    u.z * v.x - u.x * v.z,
    u.x * v.y - u.y * v.x ⟩

end Vec3

namespace ZornMatrix
variable [Ring R]

@[simp] def zero : ZornMatrix R := ⟨0, 0, 0, 0⟩
@[simp] def one  : ZornMatrix R := ⟨1, 0, 0, 1⟩
@[simp] def add (X Y : ZornMatrix R) : ZornMatrix R := ⟨X.a + Y.a, X.u + Y.u, X.v + Y.v, X.d + Y.d⟩

instance : One (ZornMatrix R)  := ⟨one⟩
instance : Add (ZornMatrix R)  := ⟨add⟩
instance : Neg (ZornMatrix R)  := ⟨neg⟩
instance : Sub (ZornMatrix R)  := ⟨sub⟩

@[simp] def mul (X Y : ZornMatrix R) : ZornMatrix R where
  a := X.a * Y.a + Vec3.dot X.u Y.v
  u := Vec3.smulLeft X.a Y.u + Vec3.smulRight X.u Y.d - Vec3.cross X.v Y.v
  v := Vec3.smulRight X.v Y.a + Vec3.smulLeft X.d Y.v + Vec3.cross X.u Y.u
  d := Vec3.dot X.v Y.u + X.d * Y.d

instance : Mul (ZornMatrix R) := ⟨mul⟩

theorem campbell_meyer_drazin_equations
    {M P C N B : Matrix n n R} (hD : DrazinResolution M P C N B) :
    B * M * B = B ∧
    B * M = M * B ∧
    B * M * M = C := by
  have hBM : B * M = P := by
    have hBN : B * N = 0 := by
      calc B * N
        _ = (B * P) * N := by rw [hD.backward_right]
        _ = B * (P * N) := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc B P N]
        _ = B * 0       := by rw [hD.nilp_left]
        _ = 0           := by rw [Matrix.mul_zero]
    calc B * M
      _ = B * (C + N)   := by rw [hD.decomp]
      _ = B * C + B * N := by rw [mul_add]
      _ = P + 0         := by rw [hD.core_left_inv, hBN]
      _ = P             := by rw [add_zero]
  have hMB : M * B = P := by
    have hNB : N * B = 0 := by
      calc N * B
        _ = N * (P * B) := by rw [hD.backward_left]
        _ = (N * P) * B := by rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc N P B]
        _ = 0 * B       := by rw [hD.nilp_right]
        _ = 0           := by rw [Matrix.zero_mul]
    calc M * B
      _ = (C + N) * B   := by rw [hD.decomp]
      _ = C * B + N * B := by rw [add_mul]
      _ = P + 0         := by rw [hD.core_right_inv, hNB]
      _ = P             := by rw [add_zero]
  have hPM : P * M = C := by
    calc P * M
      _ = P * (C + N)   := by rw [hD.decomp]
      _ = P * C + P * N := by rw [mul_add]
      _ = C + 0         := by rw [hD.core_left, hD.nilp_left]
      _ = C             := by rw [add_zero]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hBM, hD.backward_left]
  · rw [hBM, hMB]
  · rw [hBM, hPM]

structure DrazinResolution (M P C N B_inv : B) : Prop where

  decomp         : M = C + N
  core_left      : P * C = C
  core_right     : C * P = C
  nilp_left      : P * N = 0
  nilp_right     : N * P = 0
  backward_left  : P * B_inv = B_inv
  backward_right : B_inv * P = B_inv
  core_left_inv  : B_inv * C = P
  core_right_inv : C * B_inv = P

/-- **Theorem A₉₀.1 (Campbell–Meyer Drazin Inverse Equations Over Any Ring `B`):**
